-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/SafeMath.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!native
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	SafeMath.luau
	Finite-number guards for anything that feeds projectile motion. Roblox
	Vector3 components are float32, so a NaN or inf that slips into a
	position/velocity poisons every Dot/Magnitude/raycast after it, and a
	value that is merely enormous can still overflow once squared. Everything
	here clamps to Limit instead of rejecting, so a client aiming at
	Vector3.new(math.huge, 0, 0) still gets a sensible +X shot.

	API:
	 SafeMath.Limit                          -- 1e9; see below
	 SafeMath.isFinite(x) -> boolean
	 SafeMath.isFiniteVector(v) -> boolean   -- every component within +-Limit
	 SafeMath.number(value, fallback, min?, max?) -> number
	 SafeMath.cap(value, min?) -> number     -- like number(), but >= Limit means "no cap" (math.huge)
	 SafeMath.vector(value, fallback) -> Vector3
	 SafeMath.direction(v, fallback) -> Vector3  -- unit vector of an already-finite v
	 SafeMath.unit(value, fallback) -> Vector3   -- sanitize, then direction()
]]

local SafeMath = {}

-- Absurdly large for any real gameplay value, yet its square (1e18) is far
-- inside float32 range (~3.4e38), so Magnitude/Dot on a clamped Vector3 can
-- never overflow to inf.
local LIMIT = 1e9
SafeMath.Limit = LIMIT

-- Below this largest-component size a vector is treated as having no
-- direction. It sits above float32's subnormal range, where dividing stops
-- being exact; anything larger -- however tiny -- still normalizes exactly.
local TINY = 1e-30

function SafeMath.isFinite(x: number): boolean
	return x == x and x > -math.huge and x < math.huge
end

function SafeMath.hasNaN(v: Vector3): boolean
	return v.X ~= v.X or v.Y ~= v.Y or v.Z ~= v.Z
end

-- NaN fails every comparison, so `<=` doubles as the NaN check.
function SafeMath.isFiniteVector(v: Vector3): boolean
	return math.abs(v.X) <= LIMIT and math.abs(v.Y) <= LIMIT and math.abs(v.Z) <= LIMIT
end

-- Non-numbers and NaN fall back; +-inf and anything past +-Limit clamp to
-- the nearest bound. `min`/`max` narrow the range further (never widen it).
function SafeMath.number(value: unknown, fallback: number, min: number?, max: number?): number
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then
		return fallback
	end
	local low = math.max(min or -LIMIT, -LIMIT)
	local high = math.max(math.min(max or LIMIT, LIMIT), low)
	return math.clamp(value, low, high)
end

-- For fields where math.huge is a meaningful "unlimited" sentinel (MaxSpeed,
-- VisualRange): NaN and anything at or past Limit become math.huge.
function SafeMath.cap(value: unknown, min: number?): number
	if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or value >= LIMIT then
		return math.huge
	end
	return math.max(value, min or 0)
end

local function clampComponent(x: number): number
	if x ~= x then
		return 0
	end
	return math.clamp(x, -LIMIT, LIMIT)
end

-- Non-Vector3 values fall back; NaN components become 0 and +-inf/huge
-- components clamp to +-Limit.
function SafeMath.vector(value: unknown, fallback: Vector3): Vector3
	if typeof(value) ~= "Vector3" then
		return fallback
	end
	if SafeMath.isFiniteVector(value) then
		return value
	end
	return Vector3.new(clampComponent(value.X), clampComponent(value.Y), clampComponent(value.Z))
end

-- Unit vector along `v`, or `fallback` when it has no usable direction.
-- Rescaling by the largest component first means neither a tiny vector
-- (whose squared magnitude would underflow) nor a huge one (which would
-- overflow) loses its direction. Hot-path safe for internally maintained,
-- already-finite vectors; use unit() for anything from outside.
function SafeMath.direction(v: Vector3, fallback: Vector3): Vector3
	local largest = math.max(math.abs(v.X), math.abs(v.Y), math.abs(v.Z))
	if largest >= TINY and largest < math.huge then
		local unit = (v / largest).Unit
		-- math.max can swallow a NaN component, so check the result itself.
		if unit.X == unit.X and unit.Y == unit.Y and unit.Z == unit.Z then
			return unit
		end
	end
	return fallback
end

function SafeMath.unit(value: unknown, fallback: Vector3): Vector3
	return SafeMath.direction(SafeMath.vector(value, Vector3.zero), fallback)
end

return SafeMath
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/SafeMath.luau

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/Signal.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!optimize 2
--[[
	Signal.luau
	A lightweight, allocation-friendly signal used across the framework for
	entity events (Damaged, Died, ...), hitbox hits, and anything else that
	needs an event without a BindableEvent round-trip.

	API:
	 Signal.new() -> Signal
	 signal:Connect(fn) -> Connection      (Connection has :Disconnect())
	 signal:Once(fn) -> Connection
	 signal:Wait() -> ...                   (yields the calling coroutine)
	 signal:Fire(...)
	 signal:DisconnectAll()
	 signal:Destroy()

	Handlers are dispatched on fresh threads (task.spawn) so a throwing or
	yielding listener never blocks or breaks :Fire() for the others.
]]

local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal

local Connection = {}
Connection.__index = Connection

function Connection:Disconnect()
	if not self.Connected then
		return
	end
	self.Connected = false
	local connections = self._signal._connections
	local index = table.find(connections, self)
	if index then
		local n = #connections
		connections[index] = connections[n]
		connections[n] = nil
	end
end
Connection.Destroy = Connection.Disconnect

function Signal.new()
	return setmetatable({ _connections = {} }, Signal)
end

function Signal:Connect(fn: (...any) -> ())
	local connection = setmetatable({
		Connected = true,
		_signal = self,
		_fn = fn,
	}, Connection)
	table.insert(self._connections, connection)
	return connection
end

function Signal:Once(fn: (...any) -> ())
	local connection
	connection = self:Connect(function(...)
		if connection.Connected then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		fn(...)
	end)
	return connection
end

function Signal:Wait(): ...any
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	local connection
	connection = self:Connect(function(...)
		connection:Disconnect()
		task.spawn(thread, ...)
	end)
	return coroutine.yield()
end

function Signal:Fire(...)
	-- Iterate over a snapshot so listeners may disconnect (or the signal be
	-- destroyed) mid-dispatch without corrupting the loop.
	local connections = self._connections
	for i = #connections, 1, -1 do
		local connection = connections[i]
		if connection and connection.Connected then
			task.spawn(connection._fn, ...)
		end
	end
end

function Signal:DisconnectAll()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection.Connected = false
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
end

function Signal:Destroy()
	self:DisconnectAll()
end

return Signal
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/Signal.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/Heartbeat.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!optimize 2
--[[
	Heartbeat.luau
	The heart of Relativity's time model. A single RunService.Heartbeat
	connection drives every system in the game. Each frame the real delta is
	multiplied by a global time scale (SetGlobalTimeScale) and then, per
	connection, by that connection's own TimeScale — so every system runs in
	its own flow of time and the whole world can be slowed, sped up, or frozen
	at once.

	    dilatedDt = realDt * globalTimeScale * connection.TimeScale

	Callbacks receive that dilated dt. Higher-level systems (Entity, Hitbox,
	Projectile) multiply it further by a chunk-local scale (see ChunkManager),
	giving per-region time dilation for free.

	Priority: connections run in ascending Priority order (more-negative first),
	so a system at Priority -100 resolves before one at 0. This lets, e.g.,
	chunk load state settle before entity updates read it.

	API:
	 Heartbeat.Connect(fn(dt, connection), options?) -> Connection
	 Heartbeat.ConnectInterval(interval, fn(elapsed, connection), options?) -> Connection
	 Heartbeat.Delay(seconds, fn(elapsed)) -> Connection      (dilated one-shot)
	 Heartbeat.Wait(seconds) -> elapsed                        (yields in dilated time)
	 Heartbeat.SetGlobalTimeScale(scale) / GetGlobalTimeScale() -> number
	 Heartbeat.GetStats() -> { ConnectionCount, GlobalTimeScale, AvgFrameTime }
	 Heartbeat.GetConnections() -> { Connection }

	 options: { Name?, Priority? = 0, TimeScale? = 1 }
	 Connection fields: Name, Priority, TimeScale, LocalTime, Connected
	 Connection methods: :Disconnect()
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Heartbeat = {}

local connections = {} -- priority-sorted (ascending) array of Connection
local globalTimeScale = 1
local needsSort = false

-- rolling average of per-frame cost (seconds) over a fixed window
local WINDOW = 60
local frameSamples = table.create(WINDOW, 0)
local frameCostSum = 0
local sampleCursor = 1
local sampleCount = 0

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Connection
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local Connection = {}
Connection.__index = Connection

function Connection:Disconnect()
	if not self.Connected then
		return
	end
	self.Connected = false
	local index = table.find(connections, self)
	if index then
		table.remove(connections, index) -- preserve sorted order
	end
end
Connection.Destroy = Connection.Disconnect

local function makeConnection(fn: (number, any) -> (), options)
	options = options or {}
	local connection = setmetatable({
		Connected = true,
		Callback = fn,
		Name = options.Name or "Anonymous",
		Priority = options.Priority or 0,
		TimeScale = math.max(options.TimeScale or 1, 0),
		LocalTime = 0,
		_isInterval = false,
		_interval = 0,
		_accumulator = 0,
	}, Connection)
	table.insert(connections, connection)
	needsSort = true
	return connection
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Public registration
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Heartbeat.Connect(fn: (dt: number, connection: any) -> (), options: any?)
	return makeConnection(fn, options)
end

-- Fires roughly every `interval` dilated seconds. The callback receives the
-- accumulated dilated time since it last fired (usually ~= interval).
function Heartbeat.ConnectInterval(interval: number, fn: (elapsed: number, connection: any) -> (), options: any?)
	local connection = makeConnection(fn, options)
	connection._isInterval = true
	connection._interval = math.max(interval, 0)
	return connection
end

-- One-shot after `seconds` dilated seconds. Stretches automatically when time
-- is slowed globally or by the connection's TimeScale.
function Heartbeat.Delay(seconds: number, fn: (elapsed: number) -> (), options: any?)
	local elapsed = 0
	return Heartbeat.Connect(function(dt, connection)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed >= seconds then
			connection:Disconnect()
			fn(elapsed)
		end
	end, options or { Name = "Heartbeat.Delay" })
end

-- Yields the calling coroutine for `seconds` dilated seconds.
function Heartbeat.Wait(seconds: number?): number
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	Heartbeat.Delay(seconds or 0, function(elapsed)
		task.spawn(thread, elapsed)
	end)
	return coroutine.yield()
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Global time scale
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Heartbeat.SetGlobalTimeScale(scale: number)
	globalTimeScale = math.max(scale or 1, 0)
end

function Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale(): number
	return globalTimeScale
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Introspection
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Heartbeat.GetStats()
	return {
		ConnectionCount = #connections,
		GlobalTimeScale = globalTimeScale,
		AvgFrameTime = sampleCount > 0 and frameCostSum / sampleCount or 0,
	}
end

function Heartbeat.GetConnections()
	return table.clone(connections)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The one true loop
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function step(realDt: number)
	if needsSort then
		table.sort(connections, function(a, b)
			return a.Priority < b.Priority
		end)
		needsSort = false
	end

	local startClock = os.clock()
	local globalDt = realDt * globalTimeScale

	-- Snapshot so a callback may connect/disconnect during the frame without
	-- skipping or double-running siblings. New connections run next frame.
	local snapshot = table.clone(connections)
	for i = 1, #snapshot do
		local connection = snapshot[i]
		if connection.Connected then
			local dilatedDt = globalDt * connection.TimeScale
			connection.LocalTime += dilatedDt

			if connection._isInterval then
				connection._accumulator += dilatedDt
				if connection._accumulator >= connection._interval then
					local elapsed = connection._accumulator
					connection._accumulator = 0
					local ok, err = pcall(connection.Callback, elapsed, connection)
					if not ok then
						warn(`[Heartbeat] "{connection.Name}" errored: {err}`)
					end
				end
			else
				local ok, err = pcall(connection.Callback, dilatedDt, connection)
				if not ok then
					warn(`[Heartbeat] "{connection.Name}" errored: {err}`)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- rolling frame-cost stats
	local cost = os.clock() - startClock
	frameCostSum -= frameSamples[sampleCursor]
	frameSamples[sampleCursor] = cost
	frameCostSum += cost
	sampleCursor = sampleCursor % WINDOW + 1
	sampleCount = math.min(sampleCount + 1, WINDOW)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)

return Heartbeat
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/Heartbeat.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/VisualOffload.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!optimize 2
--[[
	VisualOffload.luau
	A thin publish/subscribe layer over a single RemoteEvent. The server stays
	authoritative over simulation but offloads *cosmetic* work to clients:
	 - ChunkManager mirrors chunk + global time scales so client-side visual
	   simulation dilates identically to the server.
	 - Projectile streams spawn/hit events so clients render tracers instead of
	   the server replicating a moving part per bullet.

	Messages are addressed by a string channel. Handlers registered with :On
	fire for every message on that channel.

	API:
	 VisualOffload.Fire(channel, payload)            -- server -> all clients (or client -> server)
	 VisualOffload.FireClient(player, channel, payload)   -- server only
	 VisualOffload.On(channel, handler) -> { Disconnect }
	     server handler: handler(payload, player)
	     client handler: handler(payload)
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local REMOTE_NAME = "VisualOffloadRemote"

local VisualOffload = {}

local handlers: { [string]: { (any, any?) -> () } } = {}
local remote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local listening = false

local function getRemote(): RemoteEvent
	if remote then
		return remote
	end
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(REMOTE_NAME)
		if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			remote = existing
		else
			local created = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
			created.Name = REMOTE_NAME
			created.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
			remote = created
		end
	else
		remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(REMOTE_NAME) :: RemoteEvent
	end
	return remote :: RemoteEvent
end

local function dispatch(channel: string, payload: any, player: Player?)
	local list = handlers[channel]
	if not list then
		return
	end
	for _, fn in list do
		task.spawn(fn, payload, player)
	end
end

local function ensureListening()
	if listening then
		return
	end
	listening = true
	local r = getRemote()
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		r.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, channel, payload)
			if typeof(channel) == "string" then
				dispatch(channel, payload, player)
			end
		end)
	else
		r.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(channel, payload)
			if typeof(channel) == "string" then
				dispatch(channel, payload)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function VisualOffload.Fire(channel: string, payload: any?)
	
	local r = getRemote()
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		r:FireAllClients(channel, payload)
	else
		r:FireServer(channel, payload)
	end
end

function VisualOffload.FireClient(player: Player, channel: string, payload: any?)
	assert(RunService:IsServer(), "VisualOffload.FireClient is server-only")
	getRemote():FireClient(player, channel, payload)
end

function VisualOffload.On(channel: string, handler: (any, any?) -> ())
	ensureListening()
	local list = handlers[channel]
	if not list then
		list = {}
		handlers[channel] = list
	end
	table.insert(list, handler)
	return {
		Disconnect = function()
			local index = table.find(list, handler)
			if index then
				table.remove(list, index)
			end
		end,
	}
end

return VisualOffload
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/VisualOffload.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ChunkManager.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!native
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ChunkManager.luau
	Spatial chunking system. Divides the world into a grid of chunks and tracks
	which entities are inside each one. Every chunk owns a local TimeScale that
	multiplies with the Heartbeat's global time scale, so time inside one chunk
	can run slower or faster than the rest of the world (1 = global speed,
	0.5 = half speed, 0 = frozen).

	Chunks also carry a Loaded flag. When ChunkManager.FreezeUnloaded is true
	(default), entities inside unloaded chunks are skipped by the entity update
	loop and excluded from hitbox/projectile queries — this is the "don't hitbox
	check chunks nobody is using" optimization.

	Chunking is on the XZ plane by default (Y ignored); set ChunkManager.UseY
	= true before creating any chunks for full 3D chunking.

	API summary:
	 ChunkManager.GetChunk(worldPos) -> Chunk?
	 ChunkManager.GetOrCreateChunk(worldPos) -> Chunk
	 ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt(worldPos) -> number
	 ChunkManager.SetTimeScaleAt(worldPos, scale)
	 ChunkManager.SetTimeScaleInRadius(worldPos, radius, scale)
	 ChunkManager.GetChunkKeysInRadius(worldPos, radius) -> { Vector3 }
	 ChunkManager.SetTimeScaleForKey(key, scale, persistent?)
	 ChunkManager.AddTimeScaleZone(id, position, radius, scale)
	 ChunkManager.RemoveTimeScaleZone(id)
	 ChunkManager.SetLoadedAt(worldPos, loaded)
	 ChunkManager.IsActiveAt(worldPos) -> boolean
	 ChunkManager.GetEntitiesInChunk(worldPos) -> {Entity}
	 ChunkManager.GetEntitiesInRadius(worldPos, radius, options?) -> {Entity}
	 ChunkManager.GetEntitiesInBox(cframe, size, options?) -> {Entity}
	 ChunkManager.ConfigureAutoLoad({Enabled, Radius?, Interval?})
	 ChunkManager.EnableReplication(options?)  -- server: broadcast, client: receive
	 ChunkManager.GetAllChunks() / GetStats()

	 Chunk fields: Key (chunk coords), TimeScale, Loaded, Persistent,
	   Entities (set), EntityCount, Origin (world min corner)
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Heartbeat = require(script.Parent.Heartbeat)
local Signal = require(script.Parent.Signal)

local ChunkManager = {}
-- Observers settle deferred uniform motion before the time field changes.
-- Handlers must not yield.
ChunkManager.BeforeTimeScaleChange = Signal.new()
ChunkManager.ChunkSize = 64 -- studs per chunk edge
ChunkManager.FreezeUnloaded = true -- skip updates/queries in unloaded chunks
ChunkManager.UseY = false -- 2D (XZ) chunking by default

local chunks: { [Vector3]: any } = {} -- keyed by chunk-coordinate Vector3
local chunkCount = 0
local dilatedChunkCount = 0 -- chunks whose TimeScale ~= 1; see IsTimeUniform
local timeVersion = 0 -- bumped on every chunk scale / zone change; see GetTimeVersion
local autoLoadConnection = nil
local timeZones = {} -- ordered oldest -> newest; newest containing zone wins
local timeZonesById = {}
local replicationEnabled = false

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Chunk lookup
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function toChunkKey(worldPos: Vector3): Vector3
	local size = ChunkManager.ChunkSize
	return Vector3.new(
		math.floor(worldPos.X / size),
		ChunkManager.UseY and math.floor(worldPos.Y / size) or 0,
		math.floor(worldPos.Z / size)
	)
end

local function newChunk(key: Vector3)
	local size = ChunkManager.ChunkSize
	local chunk = {
		Key = key,
		Origin = key * size,
		TimeScale = 1,
		Loaded = true,
		Persistent = false, -- persistent chunks survive becoming empty
		Entities = {}, -- set: [entity] = true
		EntityCount = 0,
	}
	chunks[key] = chunk
	chunkCount += 1
	return chunk
end

local function maybeCollect(chunk)
	-- Drop empty, non-persistent, default-state chunks to keep the grid sparse.
	if chunk.EntityCount == 0 and not chunk.Persistent and chunk.TimeScale == 1 then
		chunks[chunk.Key] = nil
		chunkCount -= 1
	end
end

-- Every chunk TimeScale write goes through here so dilatedChunkCount stays exact.
local function setChunkScale(chunk, scale: number)
	if chunk.TimeScale ~= scale then
		timeVersion += 1
		ChunkManager.BeforeTimeScaleChange:Fire()
	end
	if (chunk.TimeScale ~= 1) ~= (scale ~= 1) then
		dilatedChunkCount += if scale ~= 1 then 1 else -1
	end
	chunk.TimeScale = scale
end

function ChunkManager.ToChunkKey(worldPos: Vector3): Vector3
	return toChunkKey(worldPos)
end

function ChunkManager.GetChunk(worldPos: Vector3)
	return chunks[toChunkKey(worldPos)]
end

function ChunkManager.GetChunkByKey(key: Vector3)
	return chunks[key]
end

function ChunkManager.GetOrCreateChunk(worldPos: Vector3)
	local key = toChunkKey(worldPos)
	return chunks[key] or newChunk(key)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Time scale & load state
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Chunk-local time scale at a position (1 when no chunk exists there).
function ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt(worldPos: Vector3): number
	for i = #timeZones, 1, -1 do
		local zone = timeZones[i]
		local offset = worldPos - zone.Position
		if offset:Dot(offset) <= zone.Radius * zone.Radius then
			return zone.Scale
		end
	end
	local chunk = chunks[toChunkKey(worldPos)]
	return chunk and chunk.TimeScale or 1
end

-- True when GetTimeScaleAt is 1 everywhere (no dilated chunk, no zone), so
-- per-step boundary searches can be skipped entirely.
-- Changes whenever any chunk time scale or zone changes -- lets mirrors (the
-- parallel projectile workers) resync only when something actually changed.
function ChunkManager.GetTimeVersion(): number
	return timeVersion
end

function ChunkManager.IsTimeUniform(): boolean
	return dilatedChunkCount == 0 and #timeZones == 0
end

function ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleZones()
	return table.clone(timeZones)
end

local function replicateZone(channel: string, payload)
	if not replicationEnabled or not RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	local VisualOffload = require(script.Parent.VisualOffload)
	VisualOffload.Fire(channel, payload)
end

function ChunkManager.AddTimeScaleZone(id: any, position: Vector3, radius: number, scale: number)
	timeVersion += 1
	ChunkManager.BeforeTimeScaleChange:Fire()
	local existing = timeZonesById[id]
	if existing then
		local index = table.find(timeZones, existing)
		if index then
			table.remove(timeZones, index)
		end
	end
	local zone = {
		Id = id,
		Position = position,
		Radius = math.max(radius, 0),
		Scale = math.max(scale, 0),
	}
	timeZonesById[id] = zone
	table.insert(timeZones, zone)
	replicateZone("TimeZoneUpsert", zone)
	return zone
end

function ChunkManager.RemoveTimeScaleZone(id: any)
	local zone = timeZonesById[id]
	if not zone then
		return
	end
	timeVersion += 1
	ChunkManager.BeforeTimeScaleChange:Fire()
	timeZonesById[id] = nil
	local index = table.find(timeZones, zone)
	if index then
		table.remove(timeZones, index)
	end
	replicateZone("TimeZoneRemove", { Id = id })
end

-- Earliest entry/exit of a radial zone that changes the effective scale along
-- this straight segment. Projectile curvature limits keep the chord error
-- bounded before this function is consulted.
function ChunkManager.GetRadialTimeScaleBoundaryDt(position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3, maxDt: number): number
	local speedSq = velocity:Dot(velocity)
	if speedSq < 1e-8 or #timeZones == 0 then
		return math.huge
	end

	local speed = math.sqrt(speedSq)
	local direction = velocity / speed
	local initialScale = ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt(position + direction * 1e-3)
	local candidates = {}
	for _, zone in timeZones do
		local offset = position - zone.Position
		local b = 2 * offset:Dot(velocity)
		local c = offset:Dot(offset) - zone.Radius * zone.Radius
		local discriminant = b * b - 4 * speedSq * c
		if discriminant >= 0 then
			local root = math.sqrt(discriminant)
			local denominator = 2 * speedSq
			local first = (-b - root) / denominator
			local second = (-b + root) / denominator
			if first > 1e-6 and first < maxDt then
				table.insert(candidates, first)
			end
			if second > 1e-6 and second < maxDt then
				table.insert(candidates, second)
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(candidates)
	local sampleDt = 1e-3 / speed
	for _, candidate in candidates do
		if ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt(position + velocity * (candidate + sampleDt)) ~= initialScale then
			return candidate
		end
	end
	return math.huge
end

-- Full effective scale at a position: global * chunk.
function ChunkManager.GetEffectiveTimeScaleAt(worldPos: Vector3): number
	return Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale() * ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt(worldPos)
end

-- Scales an already global-dilated dt by the chunk-local rate at a position.
-- Use this in batched per-frame loops (Projectile, Hitbox) that receive dt
-- already multiplied by Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale() and only need the
-- chunk-local factor folded in on top.
function ChunkManager.ScaleDt(dt: number, worldPos: Vector3): number
	return dt * ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt(worldPos)
end

function ChunkManager.SetTimeScaleAt(worldPos: Vector3, scale: number)
	return ChunkManager.SetTimeScaleForKey(toChunkKey(worldPos), scale, true)
end

-- Key-based variant used by temporary zone systems that must restore both the
-- previous scale and persistence state without leaking empty default chunks.
function ChunkManager.SetTimeScaleForKey(key: Vector3, scale: number, persistent: boolean?)
	local chunk = chunks[key] or newChunk(key)
	setChunkScale(chunk, math.max(scale, 0))
	if persistent ~= nil then
		chunk.Persistent = persistent
	end
	ChunkManager._replicateScale(chunk)
	maybeCollect(chunk)
	return chunk
end

-- Chunk keys whose axis-aligned cells intersect a circular (2D mode) or
-- spherical (3D mode) radius. Public so debug/test visuals can show the exact
-- same discretized zone that simulation uses.
function ChunkManager.GetChunkKeysInRadius(worldPos: Vector3, radius: number): { Vector3 }
	local size = ChunkManager.ChunkSize
	radius = math.max(radius, 0)
	local minY, maxY = 0, 0
	if ChunkManager.UseY then
		minY = math.floor((worldPos.Y - radius) / size)
		maxY = math.floor((worldPos.Y + radius) / size)
	end
	local radiusSq = radius * radius
	local keys = {}
	for x = math.floor((worldPos.X - radius) / size), math.floor((worldPos.X + radius) / size) do
		for z = math.floor((worldPos.Z - radius) / size), math.floor((worldPos.Z + radius) / size) do
			for y = minY, maxY do
				local minPoint = Vector3.new(x * size, if ChunkManager.UseY then y * size else worldPos.Y, z * size)
				local maxPoint = minPoint + Vector3.new(size, if ChunkManager.UseY then size else 0, size)
				local closest = Vector3.new(
					math.clamp(worldPos.X, minPoint.X, maxPoint.X),
					if ChunkManager.UseY then math.clamp(worldPos.Y, minPoint.Y, maxPoint.Y) else worldPos.Y,
					math.clamp(worldPos.Z, minPoint.Z, maxPoint.Z)
				)
				local offset = closest - worldPos
				if offset:Dot(offset) <= radiusSq then
					table.insert(keys, Vector3.new(x, y, z))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return keys
end

function ChunkManager.SetTimeScaleInRadius(worldPos: Vector3, radius: number, scale: number)
	for _, key in ChunkManager.GetChunkKeysInRadius(worldPos, radius) do
		ChunkManager.SetTimeScaleForKey(key, scale, true)
	end
end

function ChunkManager.SetLoadedAt(worldPos: Vector3, loaded: boolean)
	local chunk = ChunkManager.GetOrCreateChunk(worldPos)
	chunk.Loaded = loaded
	chunk.Persistent = true
end

-- Whether systems should simulate/query at this position right now.
function ChunkManager.IsActiveAt(worldPos: Vector3): boolean
	if not ChunkManager.FreezeUnloaded then
		return true
	end
	local chunk = chunks[toChunkKey(worldPos)]
	return chunk == nil or chunk.Loaded
end

local function isChunkActive(chunk): boolean
	return chunk.Loaded or not ChunkManager.FreezeUnloaded
end
ChunkManager.IsChunkActive = isChunkActive

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Entity membership (called by the Entity system)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ChunkManager._addEntity(entity, worldPos: Vector3)
	local chunk = ChunkManager.GetOrCreateChunk(worldPos)
	if not chunk.Entities[entity] then
		chunk.Entities[entity] = true
		chunk.EntityCount += 1
	end
	return chunk
end

function ChunkManager._removeEntity(entity, chunk)
	if chunk and chunk.Entities[entity] then
		chunk.Entities[entity] = nil
		chunk.EntityCount -= 1
		maybeCollect(chunk)
	end
end

-- Moves the entity to the chunk containing worldPos if it changed.
-- Returns the (possibly new) chunk, and whether it changed.
function ChunkManager._updateEntity(entity, currentChunk, worldPos: Vector3)
	local key = toChunkKey(worldPos)
	if currentChunk and currentChunk.Key == key then
		return currentChunk, false
	end
	ChunkManager._removeEntity(entity, currentChunk)
	return ChunkManager._addEntity(entity, worldPos), true
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Spatial queries
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type QueryOptions = {
	IncludeFrozen: boolean?, -- include entities in unloaded/frozen chunks
	Filter: ((entity: any) -> boolean)?,
}

local function sweepChunks(minPos: Vector3, maxPos: Vector3, options: QueryOptions?, visit)
	local size = ChunkManager.ChunkSize
	local includeFrozen = options and options.IncludeFrozen
	local minY, maxY = 0, 0
	if ChunkManager.UseY then
		minY = math.floor(minPos.Y / size)
		maxY = math.floor(maxPos.Y / size)
	end
	for x = math.floor(minPos.X / size), math.floor(maxPos.X / size) do
		for z = math.floor(minPos.Z / size), math.floor(maxPos.Z / size) do
			for y = minY, maxY do
				local chunk = chunks[Vector3.new(x, y, z)]
				if chunk and (includeFrozen or isChunkActive(chunk)) and chunk.EntityCount > 0 then
					visit(chunk)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function ChunkManager.GetEntitiesInChunk(worldPos: Vector3)
	local result = {}
	local chunk = chunks[toChunkKey(worldPos)]
	if chunk then
		for entity in chunk.Entities do
			table.insert(result, entity)
		end
	end
	return result
end

function ChunkManager.GetEntitiesInRadius(worldPos: Vector3, radius: number, options: QueryOptions?)
	local result = {}
	local filter = options and options.Filter
	local extent = Vector3.new(radius, radius, radius)
	sweepChunks(worldPos - extent, worldPos + extent, options, function(chunk)
		for entity in chunk.Entities do
			local offset = entity:GetPosition() - worldPos
			if offset.Magnitude <= radius + entity.HitboxRadius then
				if not filter or filter(entity) then
					table.insert(result, entity)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	return result
end

function ChunkManager.GetEntitiesInBox(cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3, options: QueryOptions?)
	local result = {}
	local filter = options and options.Filter
	local half = size / 2
	-- conservative world-space AABB around the oriented box
	local extent = Vector3.new(
		math.abs(cframe.RightVector.X) * half.X
			+ math.abs(cframe.UpVector.X) * half.Y
			+ math.abs(cframe.LookVector.X) * half.Z,
		math.abs(cframe.RightVector.Y) * half.X
			+ math.abs(cframe.UpVector.Y) * half.Y
			+ math.abs(cframe.LookVector.Y) * half.Z,
		math.abs(cframe.RightVector.Z) * half.X
			+ math.abs(cframe.UpVector.Z) * half.Y
			+ math.abs(cframe.LookVector.Z) * half.Z
	)
	sweepChunks(cframe.Position - extent, cframe.Position + extent, options, function(chunk)
		for entity in chunk.Entities do
			local localPos = cframe:PointToObjectSpace(entity:GetPosition())
			local pad = entity.HitboxRadius
			if
				math.abs(localPos.X) <= half.X + pad
				and math.abs(localPos.Y) <= half.Y + pad
				and math.abs(localPos.Z) <= half.Z + pad
			then
				if not filter or filter(entity) then
					table.insert(result, entity)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	return result
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Auto-load: keep chunks near player characters loaded, freeze the rest
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type AutoLoadConfig = {
	Enabled: boolean,
	Radius: number?, -- studs around each character, default 256
	Interval: number?, -- refresh cadence in real seconds, default 0.5
}

function ChunkManager.ConfigureAutoLoad(config: AutoLoadConfig)
	if autoLoadConnection then
		autoLoadConnection:Disconnect()
		autoLoadConnection = nil
	end
	if not config.Enabled then
		return
	end

	local radius = config.Radius or 256
	local chunkRadius = math.ceil(radius / ChunkManager.ChunkSize)

	autoLoadConnection = Heartbeat.ConnectInterval(config.Interval or 0.5, function()
		-- gather occupied chunk keys around players
		local loadedKeys: { [Vector3]: boolean } = {}
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character.PrimaryPart
			if root then
				local center = toChunkKey(root.Position)
				local minY, maxY = 0, 0
				if ChunkManager.UseY then
					minY, maxY = -chunkRadius, chunkRadius
				end
				for dx = -chunkRadius, chunkRadius do
					for dz = -chunkRadius, chunkRadius do
						for dy = minY, maxY do
							loadedKeys[center + Vector3.new(dx, dy, dz)] = true
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for key, chunk in chunks do
			chunk.Loaded = loadedKeys[key] == true
		end
	end, {
		Name = "ChunkManager.AutoLoad",
		Priority = -100, -- resolve load state before entity/hitbox systems run
	})
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Replication (optional): mirrors chunk + global time scales to clients so
-- client-side visual simulation (see Projectile) dilates identically.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ChunkManager._replicateScale(chunk)
	if not replicationEnabled or not RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	local VisualOffload = require(script.Parent.VisualOffload)
	VisualOffload.Fire("ChunkScale", { Key = chunk.Key, Scale = chunk.TimeScale })
end

function ChunkManager.EnableReplication()
	if replicationEnabled then
		return
	end
	replicationEnabled = true
	local VisualOffload = require(script.Parent.VisualOffload)

	if RunService:IsServer() then
		-- Snapshot for a joining client, sent when IT asks (below): pushed on
		-- PlayerAdded it would usually arrive before the client registered its
		-- ChunkSnapshot handler, and VisualOffload drops messages nobody is
		-- listening for -- live-server joiners then never saw the time scales
		-- already in place. One request per player per few seconds.
		local lastRequest: { [Player]: number } = {}
		VisualOffload.On("ChunkSnapshotRequest", function(_, player)
			if not player then
				return
			end
			local now = os.clock()
			if lastRequest[player] and now - lastRequest[player] < 3 then
				return
			end
			lastRequest[player] = now
			local snapshot = {}
			for key, chunk in chunks do
				if chunk.TimeScale ~= 1 then
					table.insert(snapshot, { Key = key, Scale = chunk.TimeScale })
				end
			end
			VisualOffload.FireClient(player, "ChunkSnapshot", {
				Chunks = snapshot,
				Zones = timeZones,
				GlobalScale = Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale(),
			})
		end)
		Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
			lastRequest[player] = nil
		end)
		-- Mirror global scale changes. Polled in REAL time via a plain task loop,
		-- deliberately NOT a Heartbeat connection: every Heartbeat dt (dilated or
		-- not) is itself multiplied by the current global scale, so a poll tied to
		-- Heartbeat would stop advancing the instant the scale it's watching hits
		-- 0 -- meaning the transition INTO a full freeze could never be detected
		-- or broadcast to any client that didn't set it locally themselves. Real
		-- time keeps ticking regardless of dilation, so this always fires.
		local lastGlobal = Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale()
		task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				task.wait(0.2)
				local current = Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale()
				if current ~= lastGlobal then
					lastGlobal = current
					VisualOffload.Fire("GlobalScale", current)
				end
			end
		end)
	else
		VisualOffload.On("ChunkScale", function(data)
			local chunk = chunks[data.Key] or newChunk(data.Key)
			setChunkScale(chunk, data.Scale)
			chunk.Persistent = true
			maybeCollect(chunk)
		end)
		VisualOffload.On("ChunkSnapshot", function(data)
			for _, entry in data.Chunks do
				local chunk = chunks[entry.Key] or newChunk(entry.Key)
				setChunkScale(chunk, entry.Scale)
				chunk.Persistent = true
			end
			for _, zone in data.Zones or {} do
				ChunkManager.AddTimeScaleZone(zone.Id, zone.Position, zone.Radius, zone.Scale)
			end
			Heartbeat.SetGlobalTimeScale(data.GlobalScale)
		end)
		VisualOffload.On("TimeZoneUpsert", function(zone)
			ChunkManager.AddTimeScaleZone(zone.Id, zone.Position, zone.Radius, zone.Scale)
		end)
		VisualOffload.On("TimeZoneRemove", function(data)
			ChunkManager.RemoveTimeScaleZone(data.Id)
		end)
		VisualOffload.On("GlobalScale", function(scale)
			Heartbeat.SetGlobalTimeScale(scale)
		end)
		-- every handler above is registered now, so the reply can't be dropped
		VisualOffload.Fire("ChunkSnapshotRequest")
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Introspection
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ChunkManager.GetAllChunks()
	local list = {}
	for _, chunk in chunks do
		table.insert(list, chunk)
	end
	return list
end

function ChunkManager.GetStats()
	local loaded, entities = 0, 0
	for _, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.Loaded then
			loaded += 1
		end
		entities += chunk.EntityCount
	end
	return {
		ChunkCount = chunkCount,
		LoadedChunkCount = loaded,
		TrackedEntityCount = entities,
	}
end

return ChunkManager
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ChunkManager.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/Entity.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!optimize 2
--[[
	Entity.luau
	Turns any Model / BasePart / Humanoid rig — or nothing at all — into an
	entity with Entity.new(). Entities carry arbitrary custom variables and
	functions, a damage pipeline with stackable modifiers, tags, per-entity
	time scale, and automatic spatial chunk membership.

	Time model (per entity):
	   effectiveScale = Heartbeat global scale * chunk scale * entity.TimeScale
	OnUpdate callbacks receive a dt already dilated by all three. Entities in
	frozen (unloaded) chunks are skipped entirely.

	API summary:
	 Entity.new(instance?, props?) -> entity
	 Entity.Get(instance) -> entity?          (walks up ancestors)
	 Entity.GetAll() -> {entity}
	 Entity.GetTagged(tag) -> {entity}

	 entity:GetPosition() / :SetPosition(pos)   (SetPosition for data-only entities)
	 entity:GetPositionAt(realTime) -> Vector3  (rewound position; see history below)
	 entity:OnUpdate(fn(dt, entity)) -> connection-like {Disconnect}
	 entity:SetTimeScale(scale) / :GetEffectiveTimeScale()
	 entity:AddTag(tag) / :RemoveTag(tag) / :HasTag(tag)
	 entity:AddDamageModifier(fn) / :AddOutgoingModifier(fn) -> {Disconnect}
	 entity:TakeDamage(amount, info?) -> finalAmount
	 entity:DealDamage(target, amount, info?) -> finalAmount
	 entity:Heal(amount)
	 entity:IsActive() -> boolean            (false when chunk-frozen or destroyed)
	 Entity.RespawnDelay / Entity.SetRespawnHandler(fn)  -- forced respawn after
	                                         death; see "Forced respawn" below
	 entity:GetChunk() -> Chunk?
	 entity:Destroy()

	 Hurtbox debug visualization: set Entity.ShowHurtboxes = true (or call
	 Entity.SetShowHurtboxes(true)) to stream every entity's HitboxRadius sphere to
	 clients; call Entity.EnableHurtboxRendering() once on the client to draw them.
	 Entity.ShowHurtboxHistory = true (+ Entity.EnableHurtboxHistoryRendering() on
	 the client) shows the ENTIRE retained history as a trail of hurtboxes, colored
	 green while a sample is still within HurtboxValidWindow (fresh enough to be
	 usable for lag compensation) and red once it's older than that.

	 Signals: entity.Damaged(amount, info), entity.Died(info?),
	          entity.ChunkChanged(newChunk, oldChunk), entity.Destroyed()

	 Config props (all optional, passed in `props`; everything else in props is
	 copied onto the entity as custom data):
	   Health / MaxHealth (numbers)
	   HitboxRadius (number, default 2 — Body/Torso hurtbox radius)
	   HeadRadius (number, default Entity.HeadRadius — Head hurtbox radius)
	   HeadshotMultiplier (number, default Entity.HeadshotMultiplier)
	   HeadOffset / BodyOffset (Vector3, default zero — manual nudge on top of
	              the auto-calibrated Head position / the root position, for
	              rigs where the automatic placement isn't quite right)
	   TimeScale (number, default 1)
	   ScaleHumanoid (boolean — scale WalkSpeed/JumpPower with time dilation)
	   DestroyOnDeath (boolean — auto :Destroy() when Died fires)
	   Team / anything else -> stored as custom variables

	 Head + Body hurtboxes: purely data, no extra Instances -- every humanoid
	 entity has an independent Head sphere (radius HeadRadius) and Body sphere
	 (radius HitboxRadius), see entity:GetHeadPosition() / :GetBodyPosition()
	 (live) and :GetHeadPositionAt(t) / :GetBodyPositionAt(t) (rewound). The
	 two spheres are NOT required to nest or overlap -- HeadRadius,
	 HitboxRadius, HeadOffset and BodyOffset are independent knobs, each
	 applied as configured with no cross-clamping (an earlier version
	 auto-clamped HeadRadius to force geometric nesting; that was removed --
	 it existed only to support a since-abandoned physical-raycast design and
	 was silently zeroing HeadRadius out for any BodyOffset/HitboxRadius
	 combination it didn't like). Projectile.luau's lag-compensated rewind
	 check tests both spheres directly against these positions (Head first);
	 its live raycast path classifies a hit as "Head" by checking whether the
	 hit point falls within HeadRadius of GetHeadPosition() (real rig
	 geometry is untouched -- no CanQuery/CollisionGroup tricks, since
	 CollisionGroup-based hiding was tried and reverted after it broke
	 player-vs-floor collision).

	 Position history (for lag-compensated hit detection, see Projectile.luau):
	 every entity's real-world position is sampled on a real-time (not dilated)
	 cadence and kept for Entity.HistoryWindow seconds, so entity:GetPositionAt(t)
	 can answer "where was this entity at real time t". Sampling is throttled by
	 Entity.HistorySnapshotInterval and skipped when the entity hasn't moved at
	 least Entity.HistoryMinDelta studs, so a stationary entity's buffer stays tiny.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Heartbeat = require(script.Parent.Heartbeat)
local ChunkManager = require(script.Parent.ChunkManager)
local Signal = require(script.Parent.Signal)
local VisualOffload = require(script.Parent.VisualOffload)

local Entity = {}
Entity.__index = Entity

-- Position-history tuning (real seconds, not dilated) -- see GetPositionAt below.
Entity.HistoryWindow = 0.5 -- how far back samples are retained
Entity.HistorySnapshotInterval = 0.01 -- minimum real time between recorded samples
Entity.HistoryMinDelta = 0.5 -- studs; skip recording if barely moved since the last sample

-- Debug: when true, every entity's hurtbox (HitboxRadius sphere) is streamed to
-- clients and rendered as a translucent sphere. Flip this constant directly (or
-- call Entity.SetShowHurtboxes(true) at runtime) -- no keybind needed.
Entity.ShowHurtboxes = false

-- Debug: when true, the FULL position history of every entity streams to clients
-- as a trail of hurtboxes (see EnableHurtboxHistoryRendering). Independent of
-- ShowHurtboxes above, which only shows the single live hurtbox.
Entity.ShowHurtboxHistory = false

-- How recent (real seconds) a history sample must be to render green ("valid" --
-- still fresh enough to matter for lag-compensated hit detection) rather than red
-- ("stale" -- retained for GetPositionAt's interpolation, but old). Matches this
-- project's Shooter.server.luau MAX_REWIND by default so the debug view reflects
-- what's actually usable; tune to taste if that budget changes.
Entity.HurtboxValidWindow = 0.3

-- Head hurtbox defaults (see the module doc comment's "Hurtbox debug
-- visualization" section and GetHeadPosition/GetBodyPosition below). Copied
-- onto each entity at construction (like HitboxRadius already is), so a
-- prop override (props.HeadRadius / props.HeadshotMultiplier) still works
-- per-entity without touching these globals.
Entity.HeadRadius = 1.5 -- studs; independent of HitboxRadius, no nesting requirement
Entity.HeadshotMultiplier = 2 -- damage multiplier applied by Shooter.server.luau on a Head hit

-- Forced respawn (server only): every entity that dies is respawned this many
-- REAL seconds later -- real, not dilated, so a frozen chunk can't keep anyone
-- dead -- by the first of:
--   1. the handler from Entity.SetRespawnHandler(fn(entity) -> boolean?),
--      if it returns true;
--   2. player characters: player:LoadCharacter(), unless the player has
--      already respawned (their Character is no longer the dead one);
--   3. an entity with a Respawn function prop: entity:Respawn();
--   4. data-only entities (no Humanoid): revived in place at MaxHealth.
-- Humanoid NPCs need 1 or 3 (a dead Humanoid can't be revived in place).
-- Set Entity.RespawnDelay = nil to turn forced respawn off.
Entity.RespawnDelay = 5 :: number?
local respawnHandler: ((any) -> boolean?)? = nil

function Entity.SetRespawnHandler(fn: ((any) -> boolean?)?)
	respawnHandler = fn
end

local entities = {} -- flat array for fast iteration
local entityIndex = {} -- [entity] = array index (O(1) swap-remove)
local byInstance: { [Instance]: any } = {}
local byTag: { [string]: { [any]: boolean } } = {}
local nextId = 0

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Construction
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local RESERVED = {
	Instance = true,
	Humanoid = true,
	Id = true,
	Damaged = true,
	Died = true,
	ChunkChanged = true,
	Destroyed = true,
}

function Entity.new(instance: Instance?, props: { [string]: any }?)
	-- Idempotent: a second registration of the SAME instance returns the
	-- existing entity instead of creating a duplicate. Without this, the newer
	-- entity wins byInstance (Entity.Get resolves to it), but the older one is
	-- STILL in chunk.Entities, still tagged, still bound to the same Humanoid --
	-- a "ghost" that Projectile.Source (which points at the new entity) can't
	-- reference-equal against, so the projectile's self-exclusion in acquireTarget
	-- / _resolveEntityHit fails and it homes onto / damages its own creator.
	-- Any re-registration path (CharacterAdded/PlayerAdded timing, respawn,
	-- double-connect) converges to one live entity instead.
	if instance ~= nil and byInstance[instance] then
		return byInstance[instance]
	end

	nextId += 1
	local self = setmetatable({
		Id = nextId,
		Instance = instance,
		Humanoid = nil,
		Health = 100,
		MaxHealth = 100,
		HitboxRadius = 2,
		HeadRadius = Entity.HeadRadius,
		HeadshotMultiplier = Entity.HeadshotMultiplier,
		HeadOffset = Vector3.zero, -- manual nudge on top of the auto-calibrated head offset
		BodyOffset = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), -- manual nudge on top of the root position
		TimeScale = 1,
		ScaleHumanoid = false,
		DestroyOnDeath = false,
		IsDestroyed = false,

		Damaged = Signal.new(),
		Died = Signal.new(),
		ChunkChanged = Signal.new(),
		Destroyed = Signal.new(),

		_position = Vector3.zero, -- used when there is no instance
		_root = nil :: BasePart?,
		_headOffset = nil :: Vector3?, -- auto-calibrated Head-relative-to-root offset; nil if no Head part
		_chunk = nil,
		_updateFns = {},
		_damageModifiers = {},
		_outgoingModifiers = {},
		_tags = {},
		_baseWalkSpeed = nil,
		_baseJumpPower = nil,
		_lastHumanoidScale = 1,
		_instanceConnections = {},
		_history = {}, -- chronological { {Time, Position}, ... }; see GetPositionAt
		_lastSnapshotTime = -math.huge,
	}, Entity)

	-- resolve physical root + humanoid
	if instance then
		if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
			self._root = instance
		elseif instance:IsA("Model") then
			local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			self._root = instance.PrimaryPart
				or (humanoid and instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?)
				or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if humanoid then
				self.Humanoid = humanoid
				self.Health = humanoid.Health
				self.MaxHealth = humanoid.MaxHealth
				self._baseWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
				self._baseJumpPower = humanoid.UseJumpPower and humanoid.JumpPower or humanoid.JumpHeight
				self._root = humanoid.RootPart

				-- Auto-calibrated Head offset, measured once at spawn (see
				-- entity:GetHeadPosition() / HeadOffset). Self-calibrates to
				-- whatever rig/scale this instance actually has instead of a
				-- hardcoded magic number. Bounded WaitForChild, not a plain
				-- FindFirstChild -- a live player's accessories/appearance can
				-- still be streaming in when CharacterAdded fires (the same
				-- class of race humanoid.RootPart above already guards
				-- against for the root), so Head may not exist on the very
				-- first frame yet.
				local head = instance:FindFirstChild("Head") or instance:WaitForChild("Head", 2)
				if head and head:IsA("BasePart") and self._root then
					self._headOffset = head.Position - self._root.Position
				end

				table.insert(
					self._instanceConnections,
					humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
						self.Health = health
						-- Some deaths (e.g. Health set to 0 server-side on a
						-- client-owned character) never fire Died here; a
						-- health of 0 is a death either way. _handleDeath is
						-- idempotent.
						if health <= 0 then
							self:_handleDeath(nil)
						end
					end)
				)
				table.insert(
					self._instanceConnections,
					humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
						self:_handleDeath(nil)
					end)
				)
			end
		end
		byInstance[instance] = self
		table.insert(
			self._instanceConnections,
			instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
				self:Destroy()
			end)
		)
	end

	-- merge custom props (variables AND functions) onto the entity
	if props then
		for key, value in props do
			if RESERVED[key] then
				warn(`[Entity] prop "{key}" is reserved and was ignored`)
			else
				self[key] = value
			end
		end
		if props.Health and not props.MaxHealth then
			self.MaxHealth = props.Health
		end
	end

	-- registry + initial chunk
	table.insert(entities, self)
	entityIndex[self] = #entities
	self._chunk = ChunkManager._addEntity(self, self:GetPosition())

	return self
end

-- Finds the entity owning `instance`, walking up the ancestor chain
-- (so a raycast hitting a limb resolves to the character's entity).
function Entity.Get(instance: Instance?)
	while instance do
		local entity = byInstance[instance]
		if entity then
			return entity
		end
		instance = instance.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

function Entity.GetAll()
	return table.clone(entities)
end

function Entity.GetTagged(tag: string)
	local result = {}
	local set = byTag[tag]
	if set then
		for entity in set do
			table.insert(result, entity)
		end
	end
	return result
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Position & chunks
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Binary search over a chronologically-ordered history array: returns the index
-- of the last sample with Time <= target, or 0 if every sample is newer.
local function findBeforeIndex(history: { any }, target: number): number
	local lo, hi = 1, #history
	local result = 0
	while lo <= hi do
		local mid = (lo + hi) // 2
		if history[mid].Time <= target then
			result = mid
			lo = mid + 1
		else
			hi = mid - 1
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- Records a position sample for lag-compensated rewinding, throttled by
-- HistorySnapshotInterval and skipped if the entity barely moved since its last
-- sample. `now` is real time (os.clock()), not dilated Heartbeat time.
function Entity:_recordPositionSnapshot(now: number)
	if now - self._lastSnapshotTime < Entity.HistorySnapshotInterval then
		return
	end
	self._lastSnapshotTime = now

	local history = self._history
	local position = self:GetPosition()
	local last = history[#history]
	if last and (position - last.Position).Magnitude < Entity.HistoryMinDelta then
		return -- hasn't moved enough to justify a new sample
	end

	table.insert(history, { Time = now, Position = position })
	while history[1] and history[1].Time < now - Entity.HistoryWindow do
		table.remove(history, 1)
	end
end

-- Where was this entity at real time `time` (an os.clock() value)? Interpolates
-- between the two recorded samples bracketing `time`, falls back to the live
-- position for times at/after "now" (or if no history exists), and clamps to
-- the oldest sample for times older than the retained window.
function Entity:GetPositionAt(time: number): Vector3
	local history = self._history
	local now = os.clock()
	if #history == 0 or time >= now then
		return self:GetPosition()
	end

	local idx = findBeforeIndex(history, time)
	if idx == 0 then
		return history[1].Position -- predates all history; clamp to oldest
	end

	local before = history[idx]
	local after = history[idx + 1] or { Time = now, Position = self:GetPosition() }
	local span = after.Time - before.Time
	local alpha = span > 1e-6 and math.clamp((time - before.Time) / span, 0, 1) or 0
	return before.Position:Lerp(after.Position, alpha)
end

-- Rewound Body hurtbox center at real time `time` -- GetPositionAt() plus
-- the manual BodyOffset nudge, matching GetBodyPosition()'s live equivalent.
function Entity:GetBodyPositionAt(time: number): Vector3
	return self:GetPositionAt(time) + self.BodyOffset
end

-- Rewound Head hurtbox center at real time `time`, or nil if this entity has
-- no Head hurtbox. Only the tracked root position is actually rewound; the
-- auto-calibrated/manual offsets are applied on top of that (rotation isn't
-- tracked, matching the rest of this system) -- same approximation as the
-- live GetHeadPosition().
function Entity:GetHeadPositionAt(time: number): Vector3?
	local headOffset = self._headOffset
	if not headOffset then
		return nil
	end
	return self:GetPositionAt(time) + headOffset + self.HeadOffset
end

function Entity:GetPosition(): Vector3
	local root = self._root
	if root and root.Parent then
		return root.Position
	end
	local instance = self.Instance
	if instance and instance:IsA("Model") and instance.Parent then
		return instance:GetPivot().Position
	end
	return self._position
end

function Entity:SetPosition(position: Vector3)
	if self._root then
		self._root.Position = position
	else
		self._position = position
	end
end

-- Center of the Body/Torso hurtbox -- GetPosition() plus the manual nudge
-- (BodyOffset). This is what the Body hurtbox sphere (live + debug) and
-- Projectile.luau's rewind check use; unrelated systems (homing, AOE,
-- ChunkManager) keep using plain GetPosition().
function Entity:GetBodyPosition(): Vector3
	return self:GetPosition() + self.BodyOffset
end

-- Center of the Head hurtbox, or nil if this entity has no Head part (a
-- non-humanoid entity, or a humanoid rig with no Head child at construction
-- time). GetPosition() plus the auto-calibrated offset plus the manual
-- nudge (HeadOffset).
function Entity:GetHeadPosition(): Vector3?
	local headOffset = self._headOffset
	if not headOffset then
		return nil
	end
	return self:GetPosition() + headOffset + self.HeadOffset
end

function Entity:GetChunk()
	return self._chunk
end

function Entity:IsActive(): boolean
	if self.IsDestroyed then
		return false
	end
	local chunk = self._chunk
	return chunk == nil or ChunkManager.IsChunkActive(chunk)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Time dilation
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Entity:SetTimeScale(scale: number)
	self.TimeScale = math.max(scale, 0)
	self:_refreshHumanoidScale()
end

function Entity:GetEffectiveTimeScale(): number
	return Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale() * ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt(self:GetPosition()) * self.TimeScale
end

-- New undilated walk speed / jump power (e.g. server PlayerDefaults
-- changing mid-life); reapplied at the current time scale right away.
function Entity:SetMovementBase(walkSpeed: number, jumpPower: number)
	self._baseWalkSpeed = walkSpeed
	self._baseJumpPower = jumpPower
	self._lastHumanoidScale = nil
	self:_refreshHumanoidScale()
end

function Entity:_refreshHumanoidScale()
	if not self.ScaleHumanoid then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = self.Humanoid
	if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then
		return
	end
	local scale = self:GetEffectiveTimeScale()
	if scale == self._lastHumanoidScale then
		return
	end
	self._lastHumanoidScale = scale
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = (self._baseWalkSpeed or 16) * scale
	if humanoid.UseJumpPower then
		humanoid.JumpPower = (self._baseJumpPower or 50) * scale
	else
		-- jump height scales with time² (h = v²/2g with both v and g dilated)
		humanoid.JumpHeight = (self._baseJumpPower or 7.2) * scale * scale
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tags
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Entity:AddTag(tag: string)
	if self._tags[tag] then
		return
	end
	self._tags[tag] = true
	local set = byTag[tag]
	if not set then
		set = {}
		byTag[tag] = set
	end
	set[self] = true
end

function Entity:RemoveTag(tag: string)
	if not self._tags[tag] then
		return
	end
	self._tags[tag] = nil
	local set = byTag[tag]
	if set then
		set[self] = nil
	end
end

function Entity:HasTag(tag: string): boolean
	return self._tags[tag] == true
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Damage pipeline
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function addModifier(list, fn)
	table.insert(list, fn)
	return {
		Disconnect = function()
			local idx = table.find(list, fn)
			if idx then
				table.remove(list, idx)
			end
		end,
	}
end

-- Incoming: fn(amount, info, entity) -> newAmount. Runs on :TakeDamage().
function Entity:AddDamageModifier(fn: (amount: number, info: any, entity: any) -> number)
	return addModifier(self._damageModifiers, fn)
end

-- Outgoing: fn(amount, info, entity, target) -> newAmount. Runs on :DealDamage().
function Entity:AddOutgoingModifier(fn: (amount: number, info: any, entity: any, target: any) -> number)
	return addModifier(self._outgoingModifiers, fn)
end

-- info is a free-form table (e.g. { Type = "Fire", Source = attacker, Crit = true }).
function Entity:TakeDamage(amount: number, info: any?): number
	if self.IsDestroyed or self.Health <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	info = info or {}

	for _, modifier in self._damageModifiers do
		amount = modifier(amount, info, self)
		if amount <= 0 then
			return 0
		end
	end

	local humanoid = self.Humanoid
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		local before = humanoid.Health
		humanoid:TakeDamage(amount) -- respects ForceFields
		amount = before - humanoid.Health
		self.Health = humanoid.Health
	else
		amount = math.min(amount, self.Health)
		self.Health -= amount
	end

	if amount > 0 then
		self.Damaged:Fire(amount, info)
	end
	if self.Health <= 0 and not humanoid then
		self:_handleDeath(info)
	end
	return amount
end

function Entity:DealDamage(target: any, amount: number, info: any?): number
	info = info or {}
	info.Source = info.Source or self
	for _, modifier in self._outgoingModifiers do
		amount = modifier(amount, info, self, target)
		if amount <= 0 then
			return 0
		end
	end
	return target:TakeDamage(amount, info)
end

function Entity:Heal(amount: number)
	local humanoid = self.Humanoid
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.Health + amount, humanoid.MaxHealth)
		self.Health = humanoid.Health
	else
		self.Health = math.min(self.Health + amount, self.MaxHealth)
	end
end

local function respawn(entity)
	local instance = entity.Instance
	print(`[Entity][respawn-debug] timer fired for {instance and instance:GetFullName() or "data entity"} #{entity.Id}`) -- TEMP
	if respawnHandler and respawnHandler(entity) == true then
		return
	end
	-- Resolves only while this is still the player's current character, so a
	-- player who already respawned (Roblox's own timer, a reset) is skipped.
	local player = instance and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(instance)
	print(`[Entity][respawn-debug] player={player} currentCharacterIsDead={player and player.Character == instance}`) -- TEMP
	if player then
		if player.Parent then
			player:LoadCharacter()
			print(`[Entity][respawn-debug] LoadCharacter called for {player.Name}`) -- TEMP
		end
		return
	end
	local custom = entity.Respawn
	if typeof(custom) == "function" then
		custom(entity)
		return
	end
	-- A dead Humanoid can't be revived in place: an old (already replaced)
	-- player character or an NPC without a Respawn prop is left alone.
	if not entity.Humanoid and not entity.IsDestroyed then
		entity.Health = entity.MaxHealth
		entity._dead = false
	end
end

function Entity:_handleDeath(info: any?)
	if self._dead then
		return
	end
	self._dead = true
	self.Died:Fire(info)
	print(`[Entity][respawn-debug] death detected: {self.Instance and self.Instance:GetFullName() or "data entity"} #{self.Id} server={RunService:IsServer()} delay={Entity.RespawnDelay}`) -- TEMP

	local delay = Entity.RespawnDelay
	if delay and RunService:IsServer() then
		task.delay(delay, respawn, self)
	end

	if self.DestroyOnDeath then
		self:Destroy()
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Per-entity update callbacks (driven by one shared heartbeat connection)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Entity:OnUpdate(fn: (dt: number, entity: any) -> ())
	local fns = self._updateFns
	table.insert(fns, fn)
	return {
		Disconnect = function()
			local idx = table.find(fns, fn)
			if idx then
				local n = #fns
				fns[idx] = fns[n]
				fns[n] = nil
			end
		end,
	}
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Destruction
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Entity:Destroy()
	if self.IsDestroyed then
		return
	end
	self.IsDestroyed = true

	local idx = entityIndex[self]
	if idx then
		local last = #entities
		local moved = entities[last]
		entities[idx] = moved
		entities[last] = nil
		entityIndex[moved] = idx ~= last and idx or nil
		entityIndex[self] = nil
	end

	ChunkManager._removeEntity(self, self._chunk)
	self._chunk = nil

	for tag in self._tags do
		local set = byTag[tag]
		if set then
			set[self] = nil
		end
	end

	if self.Instance then
		byInstance[self.Instance] = nil
	end
	for _, connection in self._instanceConnections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._instanceConnections)
	table.clear(self._updateFns)

	self.Destroyed:Fire()
	self.Damaged:Destroy()
	self.Died:Destroy()
	self.ChunkChanged:Destroy()
	self.Destroyed:Destroy()
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- System loops
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Frame loop: run OnUpdate callbacks with fully-dilated dt.
-- dt here is already global-scaled by the Heartbeat.
Heartbeat.Connect(function(dt)
	for i = 1, #entities do
		local entity = entities[i]
		local fns = entity._updateFns
		if #fns > 0 then
				local chunk = entity._chunk
				if chunk == nil or ChunkManager.IsChunkActive(chunk) then
					local scale = ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt(entity:GetPosition()) * entity.TimeScale
				if scale > 0 then
					local entityDt = dt * scale
					for j = 1, #fns do
						fns[j](entityDt, entity)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end, { Name = "EntitySystem.Update", Priority = 0 })

-- History loop: real-time (not dilated) position sampling for lag-compensated
-- hit detection (see Projectile.luau). Runs every real frame -- the callback
-- ignores `dt` and reads os.clock() directly, since real network latency
-- doesn't scale with in-game time dilation. Each entity's own throttling
-- (HistorySnapshotInterval / HistoryMinDelta) keeps the actual recording cost low.
Heartbeat.Connect(function()
	local now = os.clock()
	for i = 1, #entities do
		local entity = entities[i]
		local chunk = entity._chunk
		if chunk == nil or ChunkManager.IsChunkActive(chunk) then
			entity:_recordPositionSnapshot(now)
		end
	end
end, { Name = "EntitySystem.History", Priority = -60 })

-- Slow loop: re-bucket moved entities into chunks, refresh humanoid dilation.
Heartbeat.ConnectInterval(0.1, function()
	for i = 1, #entities do
		local entity = entities[i]
		local newChunk, changed = ChunkManager._updateEntity(entity, entity._chunk, entity:GetPosition())
		if changed then
			local oldChunk = entity._chunk
			entity._chunk = newChunk
			entity.ChunkChanged:Fire(newChunk, oldChunk)
		end
		entity:_refreshHumanoidScale()
	end
end, { Name = "EntitySystem.ChunkTracking", Priority = -50 })

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Hurtbox debug visualization
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Entity.SetShowHurtboxes(enabled: boolean)
	Entity.ShowHurtboxes = enabled and true or false
	if RunService:IsServer() and not Entity.ShowHurtboxes then
		VisualOffload.Fire("HurtboxSnapshot", {}) -- clear any spheres already drawn
	end
end

function Entity.SetShowHurtboxHistory(enabled: boolean)
	Entity.ShowHurtboxHistory = enabled and true or false
	if RunService:IsServer() and not Entity.ShowHurtboxHistory then
		VisualOffload.Fire("HurtboxHistorySnapshot", {}) -- clear any trails already drawn
	end
end

if RunService:IsServer() then
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			if Entity.ShowHurtboxes then
				local snapshot = {}
				for i = 1, #entities do
					local entity = entities[i]
					if not entity.IsDestroyed then
						table.insert(snapshot, {
							Id = entity.Id,
							Position = entity:GetBodyPosition(),
							Radius = entity.HitboxRadius,
							HeadPosition = entity:GetHeadPosition(),
							HeadRadius = entity.HeadRadius,
						})
					end
				end
				VisualOffload.Fire("HurtboxSnapshot", snapshot)
			end

			if Entity.ShowHurtboxHistory then
				local now = os.clock()
				local snapshot = {}
				for i = 1, #entities do
					local entity = entities[i]
					if not entity.IsDestroyed then
						local samples = {}
						for _, sample in entity._history do
							table.insert(samples, {
								Position = sample.Position,
								Valid = (now - sample.Time) <= Entity.HurtboxValidWindow,
							})
						end
						-- the live position is always the newest, always-valid sample
						table.insert(samples, { Position = entity:GetPosition(), Valid = true })
						table.insert(snapshot, { Id = entity.Id, Radius = entity.HitboxRadius, Samples = samples })
					end
				end
				VisualOffload.Fire("HurtboxHistorySnapshot", snapshot)
			end

			task.wait(0.1) -- real time; this is a debug view, not gameplay
		end
	end)
end

local HURTBOX_BODY_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
local HURTBOX_HEAD_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60)

local hurtboxParts: { [string]: BasePart }? = nil -- ["{id}_Body" | "{id}_Head"] = debug sphere

local function ensureHurtboxPart(key: string, color: Color3): BasePart
	local part = hurtboxParts[key]
	if part then
		return part
	end
	part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = `Hurtbox_{key}`
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
	part.Color = color
	part.Transparency = 0.55
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Parent = workspace
	hurtboxParts[key] = part
	return part
end

local hurtboxRenderingEnabled = false

-- Call once on the client to draw every entity's Body (+ Head, if present)
-- hurtbox whenever Entity.ShowHurtboxes is true on the server. No-ops on the
-- server.
function Entity.EnableHurtboxRendering()
	if hurtboxRenderingEnabled or RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	hurtboxRenderingEnabled = true
	hurtboxParts = {}

	VisualOffload.On("HurtboxSnapshot", function(snapshot)
		local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		for _, info in snapshot do
			local bodyKey = `{info.Id}_Body`
			seen[bodyKey] = true
			local body = ensureHurtboxPart(bodyKey, HURTBOX_BODY_COLOR)
			body.Size = Vector3.one * (info.Radius * 2)
			body.Position = info.Position

			if info.HeadPosition then
				local headKey = `{info.Id}_Head`
				seen[headKey] = true
				local head = ensureHurtboxPart(headKey, HURTBOX_HEAD_COLOR)
				head.Size = Vector3.one * (info.HeadRadius * 2)
				head.Position = info.HeadPosition
			end
		end
		for key, part in hurtboxParts do
			if not seen[key] then
				part:Destroy()
				hurtboxParts[key] = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- History-trail rendering: every retained sample per entity, colored green while
-- still within HurtboxValidWindow, red once older. Overlapping spheres are
-- expected (denser overlap = the entity lingered there) -- kept more transparent
-- than the single live hurtbox so the trail doesn't turn into a solid blob.
local HURTBOX_VALID_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(90, 230, 120)
local HURTBOX_INVALID_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(230, 70, 70)

local historyParts: { [string]: BasePart }? = nil -- ["entityId_index"] = debug sphere

local function ensureHistoryPart(key: string): BasePart
	local part = historyParts[key]
	if part then
		return part
	end
	part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = `HurtboxHistory_{key}`
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
	part.Transparency = 0.8
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Parent = workspace
	historyParts[key] = part
	return part
end

local hurtboxHistoryRenderingEnabled = false

-- Call once on the client to draw every entity's FULL hurtbox history whenever
-- Entity.ShowHurtboxHistory is true on the server. No-ops on the server.
function Entity.EnableHurtboxHistoryRendering()
	if hurtboxHistoryRenderingEnabled or RunService:IsServer() then
		return
	end
	hurtboxHistoryRenderingEnabled = true
	historyParts = {}

	VisualOffload.On("HurtboxHistorySnapshot", function(snapshot)
		local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		for _, info in snapshot do
			for index, sample in info.Samples do
				local key = `{info.Id}_{index}`
				seen[key] = true
				local part = ensureHistoryPart(key)
				part.Size = Vector3.one * (info.Radius * 2)
				part.Position = sample.Position
				part.Color = sample.Valid and HURTBOX_VALID_COLOR or HURTBOX_INVALID_COLOR
			end
		end
		for key, part in historyParts do
			if not seen[key] then
				part:Destroy()
				historyParts[key] = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

return Entity
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/Entity.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- SECTION: Shared projectile motion and protocol
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileMotion.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!native
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	Shared projectile acceleration integration. Keeping this here ensures the
	server-authoritative trajectory and client dead-reckoning use identical
	math. Pure functions only -- chunk/time-zone lookups are passed in (see
	ProjectileStepPlanner, which wires these to ChunkManager for both sides).

	Acceleration accepts either:
	 - a Vector3 in world-space studs/s^2, or
	 - a number applied along AccelerationDirection (or current velocity when
	   no direction is supplied, preserving the original speed-up/slow-down API).

	Gravity is also acceleration: a number means that many studs/s^2 downward,
	while a Vector3 supplies a custom world-space gravity vector.

	Precision: Vector3 is float32, so a fixed nudge like 1e-3 studs vanishes
	entirely once a coordinate passes ~8k studs (the float32 spacing there is
	~1e-3). Boundary math below therefore runs on plain Luau numbers (doubles),
	and every positional nudge scales with distance from the origin via
	GetNudge.
]]

local SafeMath = require(script.Parent.SafeMath)

export type Acceleration = number | Vector3

local ProjectileMotion = {}

local EPSILON = 1e-5

-- Minimum positional nudge near the origin; see GetNudge.
ProjectileMotion.PositionEpsilon = 1e-3
-- Dilated seconds below which a substep is not worth integrating; smaller
-- slices of time are carried to the next frame, never discarded.
ProjectileMotion.MinStepDt = 1e-5
-- Maximum studs between a curved path and the straight chord cast for it.
ProjectileMotion.CurveError = 0.35
-- Chunk/zone time scales below this count as frozen. A scale of 1e-9 would
-- otherwise accumulate carried time for minutes and then spend all of it in
-- one burst the moment the projectile reaches ordinary time.
ProjectileMotion.MinTimeScale = 1e-4

-- 2^-18: 32 float32 ulps, so a nudged Vector3 always lands strictly past
-- the point it was nudged from, however far that is from the origin.
local RELATIVE_NUDGE = 2 ^ -18

-- Smallest offset guaranteed to move a Vector3 at `position`.
function ProjectileMotion.GetNudge(position: Vector3): number
	local largest = math.max(math.abs(position.X), math.abs(position.Y), math.abs(position.Z))
	return math.max(ProjectileMotion.PositionEpsilon, largest * RELATIVE_NUDGE)
end

-- Collapses negligible (or NaN) scales to a clean 0 and caps absurd ones.
function ProjectileMotion.SnapTimeScale(scale: number): number
	if not (scale >= ProjectileMotion.MinTimeScale) then
		return 0
	end
	return math.min(scale, SafeMath.Limit)
end

function ProjectileMotion.GetAcceleration(
	velocity: Vector3,
	acceleration: Acceleration?,
	accelerationDirection: Vector3?,
	gravity: Acceleration?
): Vector3
	local result = Vector3.zero

	if typeof(acceleration) == "Vector3" then
		result += acceleration
	elseif typeof(acceleration) == "number" and acceleration ~= 0 then
		local heading = SafeMath.direction(velocity, Vector3.zAxis)
		local direction = if accelerationDirection then SafeMath.direction(accelerationDirection, heading) else heading
		result += direction * acceleration
	end

	if typeof(gravity) == "Vector3" then
		result += gravity
	elseif typeof(gravity) == "number" and gravity ~= 0 then
		result += Vector3.new(0, -gravity, 0)
	end

	return result
end

-- Returns the velocity at the end of the step and the average velocity to use
-- for displacement during the step. The average makes constant acceleration
-- (including gravity) integrate as p += v*dt + 0.5*a*dt^2 instead of treating
-- the end velocity as a fixed speed for the entire frame. Speed is always
-- held within SafeMath.Limit, even with MaxSpeed = math.huge, so unbounded
-- acceleration can never overflow float32.
function ProjectileMotion.Integrate(
	velocity: Vector3,
	acceleration: Acceleration?,
	accelerationDirection: Vector3?,
	gravity: Acceleration?,
	minSpeed: number,
	maxSpeed: number,
	dt: number
): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local accelerationVector = ProjectileMotion.GetAcceleration(velocity, acceleration, accelerationDirection, gravity)
	if accelerationVector == Vector3.zero or dt <= 0 then
		return velocity, velocity
	end

	local nextVelocity = velocity + accelerationVector * dt
	local unclampedSpeed = nextVelocity.Magnitude
	local ceiling = math.min(maxSpeed, SafeMath.Limit)
	local speed = math.clamp(unclampedSpeed, math.min(minSpeed, ceiling), ceiling)
	if speed ~= unclampedSpeed then
		nextVelocity = SafeMath.direction(nextVelocity, SafeMath.direction(velocity, Vector3.zAxis)) * speed
	end

	return nextVelocity, (velocity + nextVelocity) * 0.5
end

-- Longer casts are safe for fast, mostly-linear projectiles because Roblox
-- ray/sphere casts sweep the full segment. The cap grows with speed to avoid
-- ray-count explosions, while nearby entities retain a tighter ceiling.
function ProjectileMotion.GetAdaptiveMaxDistance(speed: number, nearEntities: boolean): number
	if nearEntities then
		return math.clamp(speed / 120, 4, 64) -- roughly 120 Hz near targets
	end
	return math.clamp(speed / 30, 64, 256) -- roughly 30 Hz in empty space
end

-- Bounds the straight-chord approximation by limiting how far constant
-- acceleration can bend away from that chord during one integration step.
function ProjectileMotion.GetCurvatureStepDt(velocity: Vector3, acceleration: Vector3, allowedError: number): number
	local speed = velocity.Magnitude
	local perpendicular = acceleration
	if speed > EPSILON then
		local direction = velocity / speed
		perpendicular -= direction * acceleration:Dot(direction)
	end
	local magnitude = perpendicular.Magnitude
	if not (magnitude >= EPSILON) then
		return math.huge
	end
