	lastSmoothStep: number?,
	lastSmoothTarget: number?,
	transformFrom: CFrame?,
	transformTo: CFrame?,
	transformElapsed: number,
	transformDuration: number,
	suspendedTrails: { Trail }?,

	-- pass-by sound tracking (ProjectileClient.SetPassByHandler)
	passApproaching: boolean?, -- closing on the camera, on a line within the pass radius
	passDistance: number?, -- that line's closest distance to the camera
	passPoint: Vector3?, -- and where on it
	passDone: boolean?, -- already reported
	suspendedParticles: { ParticleEmitter }?,
}

-- ModuleScripts must return exactly one non-nil value.
return {}
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/Types.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/Prediction.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!native
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ProjectileClient/Prediction.luau
	Client dead-reckoning: the mirror of the server's Projectile Step minus
	hit detection. Substeps are chosen by the same ProjectileStepPlanner the
	server uses, and time that is too small to integrate is carried exactly
	the same way, so both sides consume identical simulated time.

	Prediction.simulate(visual, baseDt) advances one visual by baseDt
	personal/global seconds (already multiplied by visual.timeScale) and
	returns (alive, moved).
]]

local Shared = script.Parent.Parent
local ChunkManager = require(Shared:WaitForChild("ChunkManager"))
local ProjectileMotion = require(Shared:WaitForChild("ProjectileMotion"))
local Planner = require(Shared:WaitForChild("ProjectileStepPlanner"))
local SafeMath = require(Shared:WaitForChild("SafeMath"))

local Types = require(script.Parent.Types)

type Visual = Types.Visual

local Prediction = {}

local MIN_STEP_DT = ProjectileMotion.MinStepDt
local MAX_SUBSTEPS = 16

local function integrate(visual: Visual, dt: number)
	local movementVelocity
	visual.velocity, movementVelocity = ProjectileMotion.Integrate(
		visual.velocity,
		visual.acceleration,
		visual.accelerationDirection,
		visual.gravity,
		visual.minSpeed,
		visual.maxSpeed,
		dt
	)
	visual.position += movementVelocity * dt
	visual.life -= dt
end

-- Only these trajectories have an exact elapsed-time solution. Everything
-- else keeps the normal planner so skipping frames cannot change its path.
function Prediction.canDefer(visual: Visual): boolean
	return ChunkManager.IsTimeUniform()
		and visual.simulationDebt == 0
		and visual.minSpeed <= 0
		and visual.maxSpeed == math.huge
		and (typeof(visual.acceleration) ~= "number" or visual.acceleration == 0)
end

-- Cheap visibility probe without advancing any simulation state. Using the
-- current projected position (not the frozen exit pose) also detects shots
-- that fly into view while the camera stays still.
function Prediction.projectDeferred(visual: Visual, dt: number): Vector3
	dt = math.min(math.max(dt, 0), math.max(visual.life, 0))
	local acceleration = ProjectileMotion.GetAcceleration(
		visual.velocity, visual.acceleration, visual.accelerationDirection, visual.gravity
	)
	return visual.position + visual.velocity * dt + acceleration * (0.5 * dt * dt)
end

-- Used before a world time-field mutation: settle the old uniform interval
-- before any new zone could be applied retroactively to the deferred time.
function Prediction.settleDeferred(visual: Visual, dt: number)
	if dt > 0 then integrate(visual, math.min(dt, math.max(visual.life, 0))) end
end

function Prediction.simulate(visual: Visual, baseDt: number): (boolean, boolean)
	if not (baseDt > 0) then
		return true, false
	end

	local remaining = baseDt + visual.simulationDebt
	visual.simulationDebt = 0
	local uniformTime = ChunkManager.IsTimeUniform()

	-- Fast path: with no dilation anywhere there are no boundaries to stop at,
	-- and constant (vector/gravity) acceleration without speed clamps is
	-- integrated exactly by one averaged-velocity step. The substep loop below
	-- only exists for boundaries, clamps and velocity-relative acceleration.
	if
		uniformTime
		and visual.minSpeed <= 0
		and visual.maxSpeed == math.huge
		and (typeof(visual.acceleration) ~= "number" or visual.acceleration == 0)
	then
		integrate(visual, math.min(remaining, visual.life))
		return visual.life > MIN_STEP_DT and SafeMath.isFiniteVector(visual.position), true
	end

	local moved = false
	local guard = 0
	while remaining > MIN_STEP_DT and guard < MAX_SUBSTEPS do
		guard += 1
		if visual.life <= MIN_STEP_DT then
			return false, moved
		end

		local accelerationVector = ProjectileMotion.GetAcceleration(
			visual.velocity,
			visual.acceleration,
			visual.accelerationDirection,
			visual.gravity
		)
		local _, chunkScale = Planner.Sample(visual.position, visual.velocity, accelerationVector, uniformTime)
		if chunkScale <= 0 then
			remaining = 0
			break
		end

		-- The client can't see entities, so it always plans at the fine
		-- resolution; that only changes where substeps fall, not the path.
		local stepDt = Planner.StepDt(
			visual.position,
			visual.velocity,
			accelerationVector,
			chunkScale,
			remaining,
			visual.life,
			true,
			uniformTime,
			math.huge
		)
		if stepDt <= 0 then
			break
		end

		integrate(visual, stepDt)
		remaining -= stepDt / chunkScale
		moved = true
		if visual.life <= MIN_STEP_DT then
			return false, moved
		end
	end

	-- Carry whatever wasn't simulated, exactly like the server's Step.
	visual.simulationDebt = remaining
	-- Mirrors the server expiring a projectile past SafeMath.Limit.
	return SafeMath.isFiniteVector(visual.position), moved
end

return Prediction
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/Prediction.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/View.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!native
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ProjectileClient/View.luau
	Calculation-visibility snapshot, refreshed once per frame. This gates Lua
	work only; Roblox retains ownership of draw culling. View.contains is then
	pure Luau dot products instead of one WorldToViewportPoint engine call per
	visual, which dominated the render loop at 10k visuals.
]]

local View = {}

local VIEWPORT_CULL_MARGIN = 128 -- pixels beyond each edge; avoids boundary flicker

local valid = false
local viewPosition = Vector3.zero
local viewRight, viewUp, viewLook = Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, -Vector3.zAxis
local limitX, limitY = 1, 1 -- tan(half-FOV) per axis, widened by the pixel margin

function View.refresh()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local size = camera and camera.ViewportSize
	if not camera or not size or size.X <= 0 or size.Y <= 0 then
		valid = false
		return
	end
	local cframe = camera.CFrame
	local tanY = math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView) * 0.5)
	local tanX = tanY * size.X / size.Y
	-- A pixel margin m past an edge is 2m/size in normalized device units.
	limitX = tanX * (1 + 2 * VIEWPORT_CULL_MARGIN / size.X)
	limitY = tanY * (1 + 2 * VIEWPORT_CULL_MARGIN / size.Y)
	viewPosition = cframe.Position
	viewRight, viewUp, viewLook = cframe.RightVector, cframe.UpVector, cframe.LookVector
	valid = true
end

-- Whether `position` is on screen (with margin). Everything counts as
-- visible while no camera snapshot is available.
function View.contains(position: Vector3, radius: number?): boolean
	if not valid then
		return true
	end
	local offset = position - viewPosition
	local depth = offset:Dot(viewLook)
	if radius and radius > 0 then
		return depth + radius > 0
			and math.abs(offset:Dot(viewRight)) <= depth * limitX + radius * math.sqrt(1 + limitX * limitX)
			and math.abs(offset:Dot(viewUp)) <= depth * limitY + radius * math.sqrt(1 + limitY * limitY)
	end
	return depth > 0 and math.abs(offset:Dot(viewRight)) <= depth * limitX and math.abs(offset:Dot(viewUp)) <= depth * limitY
end

return View
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/View.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/DebugRays.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ProjectileClient/DebugRays.luau
	Draws one raycast segment as a thin fading line, colored by resolution --
	receives ProjRay events streamed while the server's Projectile.SetDebugRays
	is on (see example/init.server.luau's "SetProjectileDebug" handler).
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local DebugRays = {}

-- Red = coarse cast through an empty chunk; green = fine cast near entities.
local RAY_LOWRES_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
local RAY_HIGHRES_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 140)

function DebugRays.Draw(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, lowRes: boolean?)
	local delta = to - from
	local dist = delta.Magnitude
	if dist < 1e-3 then
		return
	end
	local line = Instance.new("Part")
	line.Anchored = true
	line.CanCollide = false
	line.CanQuery = false
	line.CanTouch = false
	line.CastShadow = false
	line.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	line.Color = lowRes and RAY_LOWRES_COLOR or RAY_HIGHRES_COLOR
	line.Size = Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, dist)
	line.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((from + to) * 0.5, to)
	line.Transparency = 0.15
	line.Parent = workspace
	TweenService:Create(line, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
	task.delay(0.3, function()
		line:Destroy()
	end)
end

return DebugRays
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/DebugRays.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/Impact.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ProjectileClient/Impact.luau
	Hit-effect visuals -- a short neon flash + spreading ring at the impact
	point, color-coded by what was struck. Games can swap this out entirely
	via Impact.SetHandler(fn(position, normal, model, kind)).
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Impact = {}

-- The built-in flash ball + ring is off by default (spell explosions and
-- authored effects cover impacts now). Set true to bring it back; a custom
-- handler from SetHandler always runs regardless.
Impact.DefaultEnabled = false

-- Custom impact hook: fn(position, normal, model?, kind). When set, it replaces
-- the built-in effect below. (model is nil for impacts; kind is
-- "entity" | "world" | "bounce" | "detonate".)
local impactHandler: ((Vector3, Vector3, Instance?, string?) -> ())? = nil

function Impact.SetHandler(fn: ((Vector3, Vector3, Instance?, string?) -> ())?)
	impactHandler = fn
end

local IMPACT_COLORS: { [string]: Color3 } = {
	entity = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), -- hit a damageable target
	world = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 150), -- hit geometry
	bounce = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255), -- ricochet
	detonate = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 60), -- spell trigger ended the bolt mid-air
}

local function defaultImpact(position: Vector3, normal: Vector3, kind: string?)
	local color = IMPACT_COLORS[kind or "world"] or IMPACT_COLORS.world
	local big = kind ~= "bounce"
	local info = TweenInfo.new(big and 0.28 or 0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

	-- expanding core flash
	local burst = Instance.new("Part")
	burst.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	burst.Size = Vector3.one * (big and 0.6 or 0.3)
	burst.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
	burst.Anchored = true
	burst.CanCollide = false
	burst.CanQuery = false
	burst.CanTouch = false
	burst.CastShadow = false
	burst.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	burst.Color = color
	burst.Transparency = 0.1
	burst.Parent = workspace
	TweenService:Create(burst, info, { Size = Vector3.one * (big and 3.5 or 1.5), Transparency = 1 }):Play()

	-- flat ring spreading along the surface (Cylinder's length runs along local X,
	-- so aim X down the normal and keep it thin there)
	local ring = Instance.new("Part")
	ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 0.5, 0.5)
	local n = if normal.Magnitude > 1e-3 then normal.Unit else Vector3.yAxis
	ring.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + n) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
	ring.Anchored = true
	ring.CanCollide = false
	ring.CanQuery = false
	ring.CanTouch = false
	ring.CastShadow = false
	ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ring.Color = color
	ring.Transparency = 0.2
	ring.Parent = workspace
	local ringSpan = big and 4 or 2
	TweenService:Create(ring, info, { Size = Vector3.new(0.12, ringSpan, ringSpan), Transparency = 1 }):Play()

	task.delay(info.Time, function()
		burst:Destroy()
		ring:Destroy()
	end)
end

function Impact.Play(position: Vector3, normal: Vector3?, kind: string?)
	local n = normal or Vector3.yAxis
	if impactHandler then
		task.spawn(impactHandler, position, n, nil, kind)
	elseif Impact.DefaultEnabled then
		defaultImpact(position, n, kind)
	end
end

return Impact
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/Impact.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/VisualModel.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ProjectileClient/VisualModel.luau
	Builds and positions the actual Instance a projectile visual renders as.
	Pure presentation -- no networking, no gameplay state.
]]

local Protocol = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("ProjectileProtocol"))
local SafeMath = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("SafeMath"))

local Types = require(script.Parent.Types)
local BeamVisual = require(script.Parent.BeamVisual)

type Visual = Types.Visual
type Rig = Types.Rig

local VisualModel = {}

-- Defaults for ActivateParticlesOnCreate (see VisualModel.ActivateParticles)
-- when a ParticleEmitter doesn't carry its own EmitCount/EmitDelay attribute.
local DEFAULT_EMIT_COUNT = 5
local DEFAULT_EMIT_DELAY = 0

local function poseFrom(position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3): CFrame
	return CFrame.lookAt(position, position + SafeMath.direction(velocity, Vector3.zAxis))
end

-- `model` itself plus every descendant, without first copying them all into
-- one table (unpacking GetDescendants() also errors on very large models).
local function forSelfAndDescendants(model: Instance, fn: (Instance) -> ())
	fn(model)
	for _, instance in model:GetDescendants() do
		fn(instance)
	end
end

-- Built-in (non-Model) visuals are pooled per appearance: a burst otherwise
-- creates two Parts and a Motor6D per projectile and destroys them all on
-- impact. Custom Models aren't pooled -- their effects/transparency state is
-- mutated by FadeOut and would need a full restore.
local POOL_LIMIT = 4096
local pools: { [string]: { Rig } } = {}

local function builtinPoolKey(data: Protocol.SpawnPayload): string
	local spec = data.Visual
	local scale = math.clamp(data.VisualScale or 1, 0.05, 20)
	if spec then
		return `{spec.Shape}|{spec.Size}|{spec.Color}|{scale}`
	end
	return `default|{scale}`
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Styled visuals: Visual = { Style = "Orb" | "Bullet", Color, Core }
-- Built procedurally once per (style, colours) as a template Model, then
-- cloned like an authored Model. Every part is welded to a hot neon core so
-- the whole thing rides the core's Motor6D; trails/particles fade out
-- naturally on impact via FadeOut. Not pooled (their effects state changes).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local SPARK_TEXTURE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
local WISP_TEXTURE = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
local styledTemplates: { [string]: Model } = {}

local function effectPart(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Anchored = false
	for key, value in props do
		(part :: any)[key] = value
	end
	return part
end

local function weld(part: BasePart, to: BasePart)
	local constraint = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	constraint.Part0 = to
	constraint.Part1 = part
	constraint.Parent = part
end

local function trail(parent: BasePart, halfWidth: number, lifetime: number, core: Color3, glow: Color3)
	local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, halfWidth, 0)
	a0.Parent = parent
	local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -halfWidth, 0)
	a1.Parent = parent
	local effect = Instance.new("Trail")
	effect.Attachment0 = a0
	effect.Attachment1 = a1
	effect.Lifetime = lifetime
	effect.MinLength = 0
	effect.FaceCamera = true
	effect.LightEmission = 1
	effect.LightInfluence = 0
	effect.Color = ColorSequence.new(core, glow)
	effect.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	effect.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.1) })
	effect.Parent = parent
end

local function light(parent: BasePart, color: Color3, range: number, brightness: number)
	local effect = Instance.new("PointLight")
	effect.Color = color
	effect.Range = range
	effect.Brightness = brightness
	effect.Shadows = false
	effect.Parent = parent
end

local function buildOrb(core: Color3, glow: Color3): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "SpellOrb"
	local center = effectPart({ Name = "Core", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 0.9, Color = core })
	center.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = center
	local shell = effectPart({ Name = "Glow", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 1.9, Color = glow, Transparency = 0.55 })
	shell.Parent = model
	weld(shell, center)
	local halo = effectPart({ Name = "Halo", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.one * 3, Color = glow, Transparency = 0.85 })
	halo.Parent = model
	weld(halo, center)
	light(center, glow, 14, 3)
	trail(center, 0.55, 0.3, core, glow)

	local sparks = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	sparks.Name = "Sparks"
	sparks.Texture = SPARK_TEXTURE
	sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(core, glow)
	sparks.LightEmission = 1
	sparks.LightInfluence = 0
	sparks.Rate = 45
	sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.5)
	sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
	sparks.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	sparks.Drag = 4
	sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	sparks.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	sparks.Parent = center

	local wisps = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	wisps.Name = "Wisps"
	wisps.Texture = WISP_TEXTURE
	wisps.Color = ColorSequence.new(glow)
	wisps.LightEmission = 0.8
	wisps.LightInfluence = 0
	wisps.Rate = 30
	wisps.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5)
	wisps.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.3, 1)
	wisps.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	wisps.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
	wisps.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-90, 90)
	wisps.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2) })
	wisps.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	wisps.Parent = center
	return model
end

local function buildBullet(core: Color3, glow: Color3): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "SpellBullet"
	-- Long axis is Z: the pose CFrame looks along the velocity.
	local center = effectPart({ Name = "Core", Size = Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 1.8), Color = core })
	center.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = center
	local shell = effectPart({ Name = "Glow", Size = Vector3.new(0.55, 0.55, 2.4), Color = glow, Transparency = 0.6 })
	shell.Parent = model
	weld(shell, center)
	light(center, glow, 8, 2)
	trail(center, 0.14, 0.14, core, glow)
	return model
end

local function styledModel(spec: Protocol.VisualSpec): Model?
	local core = spec.Core or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local glow = spec.Color or core
	local key = `{spec.Style}|{core}|{glow}`
	local template = styledTemplates[key]
	if not template then
		if spec.Style == "Orb" then
			template = buildOrb(core, glow)
		elseif spec.Style == "Bullet" then
			template = buildBullet(core, glow)
		else
			return nil
		end
		styledTemplates[key] = template
	end
	return template:Clone()
end

local function builtinPart(spec: Protocol.VisualSpec?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	if spec then
		if spec.Shape == "Ball" then
			part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		elseif spec.Shape == "Cylinder" then
			part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		end
		part.Size = spec.Size or Vector3.one * 0.5
		part.Color = spec.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	else
		part.Size = Vector3.one * 0.4
		part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120)
	end
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	return part
end

local function makeCosmetic(part: BasePart)
	part.Anchored = false
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
end

function VisualModel.Build(data: Protocol.SpawnPayload): (Instance, Rig?)
	if data.Beam then return BeamVisual.Build(data) end
	local spec = data.Visual
	local authored = data.Model
	local styled = if spec and spec.Style and not authored then styledModel(spec) else nil
	local poolKey = if authored or styled then nil else builtinPoolKey(data)

	local pool = if poolKey then pools[poolKey] else nil
	local pooledRig = if pool then table.remove(pool) else nil
	if pooledRig then
		pooledRig.driver.CFrame = CFrame.new(data.Position)
		pooledRig.motor.Transform =
			pooledRig.driver.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(poseFrom(data.Position, data.Velocity) * pooledRig.rootOffset)
		pooledRig.root.Transparency = 0
		pooledRig.model.Parent = workspace
		return pooledRig.model, pooledRig
	end

	local model: Instance = styled or (if authored then authored:Clone() else builtinPart(spec))

	-- Scale the cloned presentation once at construction. This does not add
	-- any per-frame work and keeps gameplay collision radius server-owned.
	local visualScale = math.clamp(data.VisualScale or 1, 0.05, 20)
	local root: BasePart?
	local pivot: CFrame
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		if visualScale ~= 1 then
			pcall(model.ScaleTo, model, model:GetScale() * visualScale)
		end
		root = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		pivot = model:GetPivot()
		forSelfAndDescendants(model, function(instance)
			if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
				makeCosmetic(instance)
			end
		end)
	elseif model:IsA("BasePart") then
		if visualScale ~= 1 then
			model.Size *= visualScale
		end
		root = model
		pivot = model.CFrame
		makeCosmetic(model)
	else
		pivot = CFrame.identity
	end

	-- Drive the visual as an assembly from one stationary, invisible root. A
	-- Motor6D Transform is considerably cheaper to update every render frame
	-- than creating/cancelling Tween instances or repeatedly moving a model
	-- pivot. rootOffset preserves a custom Model's authored pivot.
	local rig: Rig? = nil
	if root then
		local driver = Instance.new("Part")
		driver.Name = "ProjectileMotorRoot"
		driver.Size = Vector3.one * 0.05
		driver.Transparency = 1
		driver.Anchored = true
		driver.CanCollide = false
		driver.CanQuery = false
		driver.CanTouch = false
		driver.CastShadow = false
		driver.CFrame = CFrame.new(data.Position)
		driver.Parent = model

		local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
		motor.Name = "ProjectileTransform"
		motor.Part0 = driver
		motor.Part1 = root
		motor.Parent = driver

		local rootOffset = pivot:ToObjectSpace(root.CFrame)
		motor.Transform = driver.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(poseFrom(data.Position, data.Velocity) * rootOffset)
		rig = {
			driver = driver :: BasePart,
			motor = motor,
			rootOffset = rootOffset,
			model = model,
			root = root,
			poolKey = poolKey,
		}
	end

	model.Parent = workspace
	return model, rig
end

local function transformFor(rig: Rig, pose: CFrame): CFrame
	return rig.driver.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(pose * rig.rootOffset)
end

local function placeFallback(model: Instance, pose: CFrame)
	if model:IsA("Model") then
		model:PivotTo(pose)
	elseif model:IsA("BasePart") then
		model.CFrame = pose
	end
end

function VisualModel.Place(visual: Visual, position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3)
	visual.transformFrom = nil
	visual.transformTo = nil
	BeamVisual.Update(visual, position, velocity)
	if visual.rig and visual.rig.beam and visual.rig.beam.group then return end

	local pose = poseFrom(position, velocity)
	local rig = visual.rig
	if rig then
		rig.motor.Transform = transformFor(rig, pose)
	else
		placeFallback(visual.model, pose)
	end
end

-- Preserve exactly which trails were emitting, then clear their positional
-- history before a culled visual is moved. Keeping them disabled until a later
-- render turn prevents Roblox from drawing a segment between the old and new
-- transforms.
function VisualModel.SuspendTrails(visual: Visual)
	if visual.suspendedTrails then
		return
	end
	local suspended: { Trail } = {}
	for _, instance in visual.model:GetDescendants() do
		if instance:IsA("Trail") and instance.Enabled then
			instance.Enabled = false
			instance:Clear()
			table.insert(suspended, instance)
		end
	end
	visual.suspendedTrails = suspended
end

function VisualModel.ResumeTrails(visual: Visual)
	local suspended = visual.suspendedTrails
	if not suspended then
		return
	end
	for _, trail in suspended do
		if trail.Parent then
			trail:Clear()
			trail.Enabled = true
		end
	end
	visual.suspendedTrails = nil
end

-- Returns the real-time grace period a visual should remain alive and
-- emitting after it first leaves the viewport. EmitDelay is included because
-- one-shot particle bursts may not have fired yet when the projectile exits.
function VisualModel.GetLongestEffectLifetime(model: Instance): number
	local longest = 0
	for _, instance in model:GetDescendants() do
		if instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local rawDelay = instance:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")
			local emitDelay = if typeof(rawDelay) == "number" then math.max(rawDelay, 0) else 0
			longest = math.max(longest, emitDelay + instance.Lifetime.Max)
		elseif instance:IsA("Trail") then
			longest = math.max(longest, instance.Lifetime)
		end
	end
	return longest
end

-- Off-screen culling eventually stops both continuous particle emission and
-- trails, but only after GetLongestEffectLifetime has elapsed. Remember the
-- exact enabled set so authored-disabled effects stay disabled on re-entry.
function VisualModel.SuspendEffects(visual: Visual)
	VisualModel.SuspendTrails(visual)
	if visual.suspendedParticles then
		return
	end
	local suspended: { ParticleEmitter } = {}
	for _, instance in visual.model:GetDescendants() do
		if instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and instance.Enabled then
			instance.Enabled = false
			table.insert(suspended, instance)
		end
	end
	visual.suspendedParticles = suspended
end

function VisualModel.ResumeEffects(visual: Visual)
	VisualModel.ResumeTrails(visual)
	local suspended = visual.suspendedParticles
	if not suspended then
		return
	end
	for _, emitter in suspended do
		if emitter.Parent then
			emitter.Enabled = true
		end
	end
	visual.suspendedParticles = nil
end

-- Instantly hides a bullet visual without destroying it: every BasePart goes
-- fully transparent, and every Trail/ParticleEmitter/Beam (and Light) is
-- either faded or deleted outright depending on waitForParticles/
-- waitForTrails (see the Projectile config's WaitForParticles/WaitForTrails --
-- both default true). Returns how many seconds of grace the caller should
-- wait before actually :Destroy()ing the model:
--  - waitForParticles/waitForTrails true (default): disabling a
--    Trail/ParticleEmitter only stops NEW emission, while everything already
--    emitted keeps fading out naturally over its Lifetime, so destroying any
--    earlier would cut those remnants off mid-air (the "unnatural deletion"
--    this exists to prevent) -- contributes that Lifetime to the grace period.
--  - waitForParticles/waitForTrails false: the instance is :Destroy()d
--    immediately instead of just disabled -- no lingering remnants, no grace
--    contribution from it.
-- Beams/Lights have no lingering emission (disabling hides them instantly)
-- and never contribute grace. Returns 0 (safe to destroy immediately) when
-- nothing in the model still needs to wait -- e.g. both flags false, or one
-- flag false and the model has none of the other kind.
function VisualModel.FadeOut(model: Instance, waitForParticles: boolean, waitForTrails: boolean): number
	local grace = 0
	forSelfAndDescendants(model, function(inst)
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			inst.Transparency = 1
		elseif inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			if waitForParticles then
				if inst.Enabled then
					grace = math.max(grace, inst.Lifetime.Max)
				end
				inst.Enabled = false
			else
				inst:Destroy()
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("Trail") then
			if waitForTrails then
				if inst.Enabled then
					grace = math.max(grace, inst.Lifetime)
				end
				inst.Enabled = false
			else
				inst:Destroy()
			end
		elseif inst:IsA("Beam") then
			inst.Enabled = false
		elseif inst:IsA("Light") then
			inst.Enabled = false
		end
	end)
	return grace
end

local function release(visual: Visual)
	local rig = visual.rig
	local poolKey = rig and rig.poolKey
	if rig and poolKey then
		local pool = pools[poolKey]
		if not pool then
			pool = {}
			pools[poolKey] = pool
		end
		if #pool < POOL_LIMIT then
			visual.model.Parent = nil
			table.insert(pool, rig)
			return
		end
	end
	visual.model:Destroy()
end

-- Hides a finished visual, then destroys it (or returns a built-in one to the
-- pool) after max(destroyDelay, FadeOut's effect grace period).
function VisualModel.Retire(visual: Visual, destroyDelay: number)
	if BeamVisual.Retire(visual, destroyDelay) then return end
	local rig = visual.rig
	local delay = destroyDelay
	if rig and rig.poolKey then
		-- Built-in visuals are a bare Part: nothing to fade, only to hide.
		if delay > 0 then
			rig.root.Transparency = 1
		end
	else
		delay = math.max(delay, VisualModel.FadeOut(visual.model, visual.waitForParticles, visual.waitForTrails))
	end
	if delay > 0 then
		task.delay(delay, release, visual)
	else
		release(visual)
	end
end

-- ActivateParticlesOnCreate support: fires every ParticleEmitter under
-- `model` exactly once via :Emit(), per its own EmitCount/EmitDelay
-- attributes (defaulting to 5 / 0s when either is missing). EmitDelay is
-- seconds from THIS call until that emitter actually emits -- 0 emits
-- inline, synchronously. Call once, right after VisualModel.Build.
function VisualModel.ActivateParticles(model: Instance)
	forSelfAndDescendants(model, function(inst)
		if inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local rawCount = inst:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
			local emitCount = if typeof(rawCount) == "number" then rawCount else DEFAULT_EMIT_COUNT
			local rawDelay = inst:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")
			local emitDelay = if typeof(rawDelay) == "number" then rawDelay else DEFAULT_EMIT_DELAY
			if emitDelay > 0 then
				task.delay(emitDelay, function()
					if inst.Parent then
						inst:Emit(emitCount)
					end
				end)
			else
				inst:Emit(emitCount)
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Starts a linear pose interpolation for a server-synced visual. The render
-- loop advances it by writing Motor6D.Transform; no Tween objects are created.
function VisualModel.SetTarget(visual: Visual, position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3, duration: number)
	local rig = visual.rig
	-- Cylinders use their own traveled path, never a pose tween that rotates
	-- an entire tail across a corner. Homing still adopts every server pose.
	if rig and rig.beam then VisualModel.Place(visual, position, velocity); return end
	if not rig or not (duration > 0) then
		VisualModel.Place(visual, position, velocity)
		return
	end

	visual.transformFrom = rig.motor.Transform
	visual.transformTo = transformFor(rig, poseFrom(position, velocity))
	visual.transformElapsed = 0
	visual.transformDuration = duration
end

function VisualModel.Step(visual: Visual, dt: number)
	local from = visual.transformFrom
	local target = visual.transformTo
	local rig = visual.rig
	if not from or not target or not rig then
		return
	end

	local elapsed = visual.transformElapsed + dt
	-- SetTarget only starts a tween with a positive duration.
	local alpha = math.min(elapsed / visual.transformDuration, 1)
	rig.motor.Transform = from:Lerp(target, alpha)
	visual.transformElapsed = elapsed
	if alpha >= 1 then
		visual.transformFrom = nil
		visual.transformTo = nil
	end
end

return VisualModel
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/VisualModel.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/BeamGeometry.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!native
--!strict
-- Pure geometry union for a sustained channel. Overlapping collinear packet
-- tails become one cylinder, not stacked bars/glow. Distinct paths stay
-- distinct: never invent a connecting chord through untraveled geometry.
local Geometry = {}
Geometry.MaxSegmentLength = 12

-- Tessellate after union, so overlaps are removed but no pooled cylinder can
-- grow into an enormous bar on a flick or a stretched time-field boundary.
function Geometry.Split(segments: { any }): { any }
	local result = {}
	for _, span in segments do
		local a, b = span[1], span[2]
		local count = math.max(1, math.ceil((b-a).Magnitude/(Geometry.MaxSegmentLength-.01)))
		for index = 1, count do
			table.insert(result, { a:Lerp(b,(index-1)/count), a:Lerp(b,index/count) })
		end
	end
	return result
end

function Geometry.Merge(paths: { any }, radius: number): ({ any }, { Vector3 })
	local families: { [string]: any } = {}
	local order: { any } = {}
	local tolerance = math.max(radius * .15, .005)
	local function quant(value: number, scale: number): number return math.floor(value / scale + .5) end
	for _, points in paths do
		-- A point is a control endpoint, not a beam body. Rounded caps are
		-- generated only for nonzero segments below; singleton snapshots must
		-- not leave floating glow dots (especially after retirement/freeze).
		for index = 1, #points - 1 do
			local a, b = points[index], points[index + 1]
			local offset = b - a
			if offset.Magnitude < 1e-4 then continue end
			local direction = offset.Unit
			local abs = Vector3.new(math.abs(direction.X), math.abs(direction.Y), math.abs(direction.Z))
			local main = if abs.X >= abs.Y and abs.X >= abs.Z then direction.X elseif abs.Y >= abs.Z then direction.Y else direction.Z
			if main < 0 then direction = -direction end
			local directionKey = `{quant(direction.X, 1/4096)}:{quant(direction.Y, 1/4096)}:{quant(direction.Z, 1/4096)}`
			local family = families[directionKey]
			if not family then
				family = { direction = direction, cells = {} }
				families[directionKey] = family
			end
			-- Use one representative direction for spatial hashing. Computing a
			-- perpendicular origin with EACH segment's float-rounded direction
			-- amplified tiny angle errors at long range and split a straight beam
			-- back into dozens of bars. Neighbor cells handle grid boundaries.
			local origin = a - family.direction * a:Dot(family.direction)
			local x, y, z = quant(origin.X, tolerance), quant(origin.Y, tolerance), quant(origin.Z, tolerance)
			local function cellKey(dx, dy, dz) return `{x+dx}:{y+dy}:{z+dz}` end
			local function fits(candidate)
				for _, point in { a, b } do
					local delta = point - candidate.origin
					if (delta - candidate.direction * delta:Dot(candidate.direction)).Magnitude > tolerance then return false end
				end
				return true
			end
			local bucket
			local key = cellKey(0,0,0)
			for _, candidate in family.cells[key] or {} do if fits(candidate) then bucket = candidate; break end end
			if not bucket then
				for dx = -1, 1 do
					for dy = -1, 1 do
						for dz = -1, 1 do
							for _, candidate in family.cells[cellKey(dx,dy,dz)] or {} do
								if fits(candidate) then bucket = candidate; break end
							end
							if bucket then break end
						end
						if bucket then break end
					end
					if bucket then break end
				end
			end
			if not bucket then
				bucket = { key = directionKey .. ":" .. key .. ":" .. tostring(#order + 1), origin = a, direction = direction, intervals = {} }
				local cell = family.cells[key]
				if not cell then cell = {}; family.cells[key] = cell end
				table.insert(cell, bucket)
				table.insert(order, bucket)
			end
			local from = (a - bucket.origin):Dot(bucket.direction)
			local to = (b - bucket.origin):Dot(bucket.direction)
			table.insert(bucket.intervals, { math.min(from, to), math.max(from, to) })
		end
	end
	table.sort(order, function(a, b) return a.key < b.key end)
	local segments, joints, seenJoints = {}, {}, {}
	local function addJoint(point: Vector3)
		local key = `{quant(point.X,tolerance)}:{quant(point.Y,tolerance)}:{quant(point.Z,tolerance)}`
		if not seenJoints[key] then seenJoints[key] = true; table.insert(joints, point) end
	end
	local function add(bucket, from, to)
		local a = bucket.origin + bucket.direction * from
		local b = bucket.origin + bucket.direction * to
		table.insert(segments, { a, b })
		for _, point in { a, b } do
			addJoint(point)
		end
	end
	for _, bucket in order do
		table.sort(bucket.intervals, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
		local from, to = bucket.intervals[1][1], bucket.intervals[1][2]
		for index = 2, #bucket.intervals do
			local interval = bucket.intervals[index]
			if interval[1] <= to + tolerance then to = math.max(to, interval[2])
			else add(bucket, from, to); from, to = interval[1], interval[2] end
		end
		add(bucket, from, to)
	end
	return Geometry.Split(segments), joints
end

return Geometry
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/BeamGeometry.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/BeamVisual.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!strict
-- Finite, traveling cylinders along a bounded path, not an instantaneous ray
-- from the muzzle to the cursor. Sustained channels share a linked centerline
-- with server collision; individual beams retain their traveled path tail.
-- Collision/damage/bounce/pierce/homing stay server-owned.
local ChunkManager = require(script.Parent.Parent.ChunkManager)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Types)
local Protocol = require(script.Parent.Parent.ProjectileProtocol)
local Geometry = require(script.Parent.BeamGeometry)
local View = require(script.Parent.View)
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Planner = require(script.Parent.Parent.ProjectileStepPlanner)
local Prediction = require(script.Parent.Prediction)
local Heartbeat = require(script.Parent.Parent.Heartbeat)
local BeamPath = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Projectile"):WaitForChild("BeamPath"))

local BeamVisual = {}
local MAX_SEGMENTS = 8
local MAX_RETIRE_UPDATES = 128
local retired: { any } = {}
local retireCursor = 1
local clock = 0
local ROTATION = CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0) -- cylinder's X axis -> path Z
local groups: { [number]: any } = {}
local pending: { [any]: any } = {}
local applyConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local predicting: { [any]: boolean } = {}

-- Advance all channel endpoints to ONE presentation epoch before joining any
-- of them. The ordinary round-robin renderer must not mix endpoint ages.
function BeamVisual.PredictGroups(now: number, simulationClock: number)
	for state in predicting do
		local visual = state.visual
		if not visual or not state.predictedAt then continue end
		if now < state.predictedAt then visual.lastSimulationTime = simulationClock; continue end
		local elapsed = math.max(now - state.predictedAt, 0)
		local _, moved = Prediction.simulate(visual, elapsed * state.globalScale * visual.timeScale)
		state.predictedAt = now
		visual.lastSimulationTime = simulationClock
		if state.group then state.group.dirty = true
		elseif moved then BeamVisual.Update(visual, visual.position, visual.velocity) end
	end
end

local function predictedPath(state: any): { Vector3 }?
	local source = state.authoritativePath
	if not source or not state.visual or not state.predictedAt then return source end
	local result = table.clone(source)
	if #result == 0 then return result end
	local position = state.visual.position
	result[1] = position
	if #result > 1 and not state.pathClipped then
		local front = state.group.byId[state.previousId]
		if front and front.visual and not front.retired then
			result[#result] = front.visual.position
		elseif state.previousId == 0 then
			-- A detached fragment translates; world bend vertices remain fixed.
			result[#result] += position - source[1]
		else
			-- The front is gone/pending; never pin a moving packet to an old
			-- spawn/impact location. Translate the last approved finite fragment
			-- until the server supplies a replacement link or a clipped anchor.
			if #result == 2 then result[2] += position - source[1]
			else return { position } end
		end
	end
	-- Prediction cannot authorize a giant collision body. Physical refinement
	-- seeds replacement nodes on the next server frame; until those arrive,
	-- don't draw a shortcut from a moving head to a stale bend/impact anchor.
	for index = 1, #result - 1 do
		if (result[index+1]-result[index]).Magnitude > BeamPath.MaxStretch * 2 then
			return { position }
		end
	end
	return result
end

function BeamVisual.AdoptMotion(visual: Types.Visual, serverTime: number?, globalScale: number?, previousId: number?)
	local state = visual.rig and visual.rig.beam
	if not state then return end
	if previousId ~= nil then state.previousId = previousId end
	if serverTime then
		state.predictedAt = serverTime
		state.globalScale = globalScale or Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale()
	end
	if state.group then state.group.dirty = true end
end

local function part(parent: Instance, name: string, color: Color3, transparency: number, initialPose: CFrame?): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name, p.Color, p.Transparency = name, color, transparency
	p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	p.Size = Vector3.one * 0.05
	p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
	-- Motor6D.Transform is applied in the engine's simulation phase. New
	-- cylinders need their correct world pose BEFORE being made visible;
	-- otherwise their default X-axis orientation flashes for one frame.
	if initialPose then p.CFrame = initialPose end
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function motor(driver: BasePart, p: BasePart, initialPose: CFrame?): Motor6D
	local joint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	-- Connecting Part1 immediately applies C0/C1, before Transform's deferred
	-- engine update. Seed C0 as well as the Part pose to prevent an axis flash.
	joint.C0 = if initialPose then driver.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(initialPose) else CFrame.identity
	joint.Part0, joint.Part1, joint.Parent = driver, p, driver
	return joint
end

local function shape(group: any, pool: any, index: number, pose: CFrame, size: Vector3, ball: boolean)
	local pair = pool[index]
	if not pair then
		local core = part(group.model, if ball then "BeamJointCore" else "BeamCore", group.core, 1, pose)
		local glow = part(group.model, if ball then "BeamJointGlow" else "BeamGlow", group.color, 1, pose)
		if ball then core.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball; glow.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball end
		pair = { core = core, glow = glow, coreMotor = motor(group.driver, core, pose), glowMotor = motor(group.driver, glow, pose) }
		pool[index] = pair
	end
	local transform = group.driver.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(pose)
	pair.core.Size = if ball then size * .55 else Vector3.new(size.X, size.Y * .55, size.Z * .55)
	pair.glow.Size = size
	pair.coreMotor.Transform = pair.coreMotor.C0:Inverse() * transform
	pair.glowMotor.Transform = pair.glowMotor.C0:Inverse() * transform
	pair.core.Transparency, pair.glow.Transparency = 0, .5
end

local function hideAfter(pool: any, used: number)
	for index = used + 1, #pool do
		pool[index].core.Transparency, pool[index].glow.Transparency = 1, 1
	end
end

-- Apply size and Motor6D pose together before the engine commits transforms.
-- Reusing a long cylinder at a new angle during Heartbeat otherwise exposes
-- its new length at the old orientation for a rendered frame.
function BeamVisual.ApplyGroups()
	for group, geometry in pending do
		pending[group] = nil
		if not group.model.Parent then continue end
		for index, span in geometry.segments do
			local a, b = span[1], span[2]
			local length = (b - a).Magnitude
			local up = if math.abs((b - a).Y / length) > .99 then Vector3.xAxis else Vector3.yAxis
			shape(group, group.segments, index, CFrame.lookAt((a + b) * .5, b, up) * ROTATION,
				Vector3.new(math.min(length, Geometry.MaxSegmentLength), group.radius * 2, group.radius * 2), false)
		end
		hideAfter(group.segments, #geometry.segments)
		for index, point in geometry.joints do
			shape(group, group.joints, index, CFrame.new(point), Vector3.one * group.radius * 2, true)
		end
		hideAfter(group.joints, #geometry.joints)
	end
end

-- One aggregation per channel per frame, never one visible bar per packet.
-- Only already-simulated paths enter the union. Offscreen packets retain the
-- normal prediction timestamp/correction rules and resume through Reset.
function BeamVisual.GetBounds(visual: Types.Visual, position: Vector3, simulationClock: number): (Vector3, number)
	local state = visual.rig and visual.rig.beam
	if not state then return position, 0 end
	local path = if state.group then predictedPath(state) else state.authoritativePath
	if path and #path > 1 then
		local low, high = position, position
		for _, point in path do low, high = low:Min(point), high:Max(point) end
		return (low+high)*.5, (high-low).Magnitude*.5+state.maxLength
	end
	return position, state.maxLength
end

function BeamVisual.FlushGroups(simulationClock: number?)
	for _, group in groups do
		for state in group.members do
			local visual = state.visual
			local visible = if state.retired then View.contains((state.points[1]+state.points[#state.points])*.5, state.length*.5+state.radius)
				else visual and visual.inView or false
			if visible ~= state.wasVisible then state.wasVisible = visible; group.dirty = true end
		end
		if not group.dirty then continue end
		group.dirty = false
		local paths = {}
		for state in group.members do
			local visual = state.visual
			local inView = if state.retired then View.contains((state.points[1]+state.points[#state.points])*.5, state.length*.5+state.radius)
				else visual and visual.inView
			if not inView then continue end
			if state.retired then
				if state.length > 1e-4 then table.insert(paths, state.points) end
				continue
			end
			-- A sustained sample renders exactly ONE server-approved path.
			-- Its old travel history is never a second tail, even after a split,
			-- clipping, interest loss, delayed pose, or missing predecessor.
			state.linkPoints = predictedPath(state)
			if state.linkPoints and #state.linkPoints > 0 then table.insert(paths, state.linkPoints) end
		end
		if #paths > 0 then
			local segments, joints = Geometry.Merge(paths, group.radius)
			pending[group] = { segments = segments, joints = joints }
		elseif group.visible then
			-- Do not leave stale cylinders at their exit pose where a camera turn
			-- could expose them while their authoritative heads are elsewhere.
			pending[group] = { segments = {}, joints = {} }
		end
		group.visible = #paths > 0
	end
end

local function releaseState(visual: Types.Visual)
	local state = (visual.rig :: Types.Rig).beam
	predicting[state] = nil
	pending[state] = nil
	local group = state.group
	if group then
		group.dirty = true
		group.members[state] = nil
		group.byId[state.id] = nil
		if next(group.members) == nil then
			groups[group.id], pending[group] = nil, nil
			group.model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	visual.model:Destroy()
end

local function trim(state: any, distance: number)
	local points = state.points
	while distance > 0 and #points > 1 do
		local length = (points[2] - points[1]).Magnitude
		if distance >= length then
			table.remove(points, 1)
			distance -= length
			state.length -= length
		else
			points[1] = points[1]:Lerp(points[2], distance / length)
			state.length -= distance
			distance = 0
		end
	end
	-- The running length drifts from the true sum of segments (float error
	-- per subtraction). A single point has no length, whatever the running
	-- total says -- otherwise a drained packet stuck a hair above the release
	-- threshold and lingered (with its channel's model) until the 60s cap.
	state.length = if #points <= 1 then 0 else math.max(state.length, 0)
end

local function append(state: any, position: Vector3)
	local points = state.points
	local last = points[#points]
	local offset = position - last
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	if distance < 1e-4 then return end
	if #points >= 2 then
		local previous = last - points[#points - 1]
		if previous.Magnitude > 1e-4 and previous.Unit:Dot(offset.Unit) > 0.9999 then
			points[#points] = position
		else
			table.insert(points, position)
		end
	else
		table.insert(points, position)
	end
	state.length += distance
	trim(state, math.max(state.length - state.maxLength, 0))
	-- Drop old detail instead of drawing a shortcut across a bend/wall.
	while #points > MAX_SEGMENTS + 1 do trim(state, (points[2] - points[1]).Magnitude) end
end

local function draw(rig: Types.Rig)
	local state = rig.beam
	if state.group then return end
	state.model, state.driver = rig.model, rig.driver
	state.joints = state.joints or {}
	local spans = {}
	for index = 1, #state.points-1 do table.insert(spans, { state.points[index], state.points[index+1] }) end
	pending[state] = { segments = Geometry.Split(spans), joints = {} }
	if not applyConnection then applyConnection = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(BeamVisual.ApplyGroups) end
end
function BeamVisual.Build(data: Protocol.SpawnPayload): (Instance, Types.Rig)
	local beam = assert(data.Beam)
	local spec = data.Visual
	local color = spec and spec.Color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 96, 28)
	if beam.ChannelId then
		local group = groups[beam.ChannelId]
		if not group then
			local model = Instance.new("Model")
			model.Name = "SustainedBeam_" .. beam.ChannelId
			local driver = part(model, "ProjectileMotorRoot", color, 1)
			driver.Anchored = true
			driver.CFrame = CFrame.new(beam.Origin)
			local root = part(model, "BeamHead", color, 1)
			group = { id = beam.ChannelId, model = model, driver = driver, root = root,
				motor = motor(driver, root), color = color, core = spec and spec.Core or Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				radius = math.max(beam.Radius, .025), segments = {}, joints = {}, members = {}, byId = {}, visible = false, dirty = true }
			groups[beam.ChannelId] = group
			model.Parent = workspace
			if not applyConnection then applyConnection = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(BeamVisual.ApplyGroups) end
		end
		-- Each logical packet owns only metadata, not cylinders/Motor6Ds. Its
		-- placeholder can retire without deleting another packet's shared rig.
		local placeholder = Instance.new("Folder")
		placeholder.Name = "BeamPacket_" .. data.Id
		placeholder.Parent = group.model
		local state = { points = { data.Position }, length = 0, maxLength = beam.Length,
			radius = group.radius, speed = data.Velocity.Magnitude, group = group,
			id = data.Id, previousId = beam.PreviousId or 0,
			predictedAt = data.ServerTime, globalScale = data.GlobalScale or Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale(),
		}
		state.authoritativePath = beam.Path
		state.pathClipped = beam.Clipped
		group.members[state] = true
		group.byId[data.Id] = state
		group.dirty = true
		return placeholder, { model = placeholder, driver = group.driver, root = group.root,
			motor = group.motor, rootOffset = CFrame.identity, beam = state }
	end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "ProjectileBeam"
	local driver = part(model, "ProjectileMotorRoot", color, 1)
	driver.Anchored = true
	driver.CFrame = CFrame.new(data.Position)
	local root = part(model, "BeamHead", color, 1)
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	local rig: Types.Rig = {
		driver = driver, root = root, motor = motor(driver, root), model = model,
		rootOffset = CFrame.identity,
		beam = { points = { beam.Origin }, segments = {}, length = 0,
			predictedAt = data.ServerTime, globalScale = data.GlobalScale or Heartbeat.GetGlobalTimeScale(),
			maxLength = beam.Length, radius = math.max(beam.Radius, 0.025),
			color = color, core = spec and spec.Core or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), speed = data.Velocity.Magnitude },
	}
	append(rig.beam, data.Position)
	draw(rig)
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model, rig
end

function BeamVisual.Attach(visual: Types.Visual)
	local rig = visual.rig
	if rig and rig.beam then
		rig.beam.visual = visual
		predicting[rig.beam] = true
	end
end

function BeamVisual.AdoptPath(visual: Types.Visual, points: { Vector3 }?, clipped: boolean?, final: boolean?)
	local state = visual.rig and visual.rig.beam
	if not state then return end
	state.authoritativePath = points
	state.pathClipped = clipped
	state.finalPath = final == true
	if state.group then state.group.dirty = true end
end

-- Interest loss is not an impact: do not leave a retired copy with the same
-- id in a channel when the authoritative re-entry snapshot rebuilds it.
function BeamVisual.Discard(visual: Types.Visual): boolean
	if not visual.rig or not visual.rig.beam then return false end
	releaseState(visual)
	return true
end

function BeamVisual.ShouldPlayImpact(visual: Types.Visual, point: Vector3): boolean
	local rig = visual.rig
	local group = rig and rig.beam and rig.beam.group
	if not group then return true end
	-- Cosmetic throttle only: every packet still delivers its server damage.
	local now = os.clock()
	if group.lastImpact and now - group.lastImpact < .1 and (point - group.impactPoint).Magnitude < 4 then return false end
	group.lastImpact, group.impactPoint = now, point
	return true
end

function BeamVisual.Update(visual: Types.Visual, position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3)
	local rig = visual.rig
	if not rig or not rig.beam then return end
	rig.beam.linkPoints = nil
	if rig.beam.group then
		rig.beam.group.dirty = true
		rig.beam.points, rig.beam.length = {position}, 0
		rig.beam.speed = velocity.Magnitude
		return
	end
	append(rig.beam, position)
	rig.beam.speed = velocity.Magnitude
	draw(rig)
end

function BeamVisual.StopBody(visual: Types.Visual, contact: Vector3)
	local state = visual.rig and visual.rig.beam
	if not state or not state.group then return end
	state.group.dirty = true
	local stop = table.clone(state.authoritativePath or { contact })
	if #stop == 1 then
		state.stopPath, state.pathClipped = { contact }, true
		return
	end
	-- The actual stop can precede a predecessor's next bounce. Retain only
	-- the contacts up to the segment containing this impact, never overshoot.
	local best, distance = 1, math.huge
	for index = 1, #stop - 1 do
		local a, b = stop[index], stop[index+1]
		local offset = b-a
		local t = math.clamp((contact-a):Dot(offset)/math.max(offset:Dot(offset),1e-8),0,1)
		local d = (a+offset*t-contact).Magnitude
		if d < distance then best, distance = index, d end
	end
	while #stop > best + 1 do table.remove(stop) end
	stop[#stop] = contact
	state.stopPath = stop
	state.pathClipped = true
end

-- Remove predicted overshoot before an authoritative bounce/impact. Retain
-- the incoming path up to the contact, then let the new heading extend it.
function BeamVisual.Correct(visual: Types.Visual, contact: Vector3)
	local rig = visual.rig
	if not rig or not rig.beam then return end
	local state, bestIndex, bestDistance = rig.beam, 1, math.huge
	if state.group then state.group.dirty = true; return end
	for index = 1, #state.points - 1 do
		local a, b = state.points[index], state.points[index + 1]
		local offset = b - a
		local t = math.clamp((contact - a):Dot(offset) / math.max(offset:Dot(offset), 1e-8), 0, 1)
		local distance = (a + offset * t - contact).Magnitude
		if distance < bestDistance then bestIndex, bestDistance = index, distance end
	end
	while #state.points > bestIndex + 1 do table.remove(state.points) end
	if #state.points > 1 then state.points[#state.points] = contact else table.insert(state.points, contact) end
	state.length = 0
	for index = 1, #state.points - 1 do state.length += (state.points[index + 1] - state.points[index]).Magnitude end
	trim(state, math.max(state.length - state.maxLength, 0))
end

function BeamVisual.Reset(visual: Types.Visual)
	local rig = visual.rig
	if rig and rig.beam then
		local state = rig.beam
		if state.group then
			state.group.dirty = true
			state.points, state.length = {visual.position}, 0
			return
		end
		rig.beam.points = { visual.position }
		rig.beam.length = 0
		draw(rig)
	end
end

function BeamVisual.Retire(visual: Types.Visual, delay: number): boolean
	local rig = visual.rig
	if not rig or not rig.beam then return false end
	if rig.beam.retired then return true end
	local state = rig.beam
	predicting[state] = nil
	if state.group then
		state.group.dirty = true
		local points = state.stopPath or (if state.finalPath then state.authoritativePath else predictedPath(state))
		state.points = if points and #points > 0 then table.clone(points) else { visual.position }
		state.length = 0
		for index = 1, #state.points - 1 do state.length += (state.points[index+1]-state.points[index]).Magnitude end
	end
	if state.speed <= 1e-4 then state.points = { state.points[#state.points] }; state.length = 0 end
	state.retired = true
	-- Drain already-traveled geometry from the tail. Hiding the whole packet
	-- on impact would leave a frame-sized hole in a sustained beam.
	table.insert(retired, { visual = visual, lastClock = clock, started = os.clock(), delay = delay })
	return true
end

function BeamVisual.StepRetired(globalDt: number)
	clock += globalDt
	local visited = 0
	local budget = math.min(#retired, MAX_RETIRE_UPDATES)
	while #retired > 0 and visited < budget do
		if retireCursor > #retired then retireCursor = 1 end
		local item = retired[retireCursor]
		local visual = item.visual
		local rig = visual.rig :: Types.Rig
		local state = rig.beam
		local elapsed = (clock - item.lastClock) * visual.timeScale
		item.lastClock = clock
		local remaining = math.max(elapsed, 0) + (state.retireDebt or 0)
		local beforeLength = state.length
		if elapsed <= 0 then
			-- Like server Step, frozen time does not spend carried simulation debt.
		elseif ChunkManager.IsTimeUniform() then
			trim(state, remaining * state.speed)
			remaining = 0
		else
			local guard = 0
			while remaining > 1e-6 and #state.points > 1 and state.speed > 1e-4 and guard < 16 do
				guard += 1
				local origin, offset = state.points[1], state.points[2]-state.points[1]
				if offset.Magnitude < 1e-4 then trim(state,.0001); continue end
				local scale = ChunkManager.GetTimeScaleAt(origin)
				if scale <= 0 then remaining = 0; break end
				local dt = Planner.StepDt(origin, offset.Unit*state.speed, Vector3.zero, scale, remaining,
					math.huge, true, false, offset.Magnitude/state.speed)
				if dt <= 0 then break end
				trim(state, dt*state.speed)
				remaining -= dt/scale
			end
		end
		state.retireDebt = remaining
		if state.group and state.length ~= beforeLength then state.group.dirty = true end
		draw(rig)
		visited += 1
		if (state.length <= 1e-4 and os.clock() - item.started >= item.delay) or os.clock() - item.started >= 60 then
			releaseState(visual)
			table.remove(retired, retireCursor)
		else
			retireCursor += 1
		end
	end
end

return BeamVisual
-- =============================================================================
-- END FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/BeamVisual.luau
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- BEGIN FILE: src/shared/ProjectileClient/init.luau
-- =============================================================================
--!native
--!strict
--!optimize 2
--[[
	ProjectileClient (client rendering, purely cosmetic)
	Receives the server-authoritative Projectile system's replication stream
	(see Shared.ProjectileProtocol for the wire format, and
	ServerScriptService.Server.Projectile/Replication.luau for the sending
	side) and renders tracers/impacts. This module never makes a gameplay
	decision -- no hit detection, no damage, no entity access -- it only draws
	what the server tells it happened. All client-side simulation between
	updates is dead-reckoning for smoothness (see Prediction.luau); the
	server's own independent Step is always authoritative, and any visual
	drift is corrected the instant ProjHit snaps the final position.

	Modules:
	 init        message handlers + the bounded per-frame render scheduler
	 Prediction  dead-reckoning physics (mirrors the server Step)
	 VisualModel building, posing, culling and retiring the rendered Instance
	 View        camera frustum test
	 Impact      hit flashes (swappable via SetImpactHandler)
	 DebugRays   ProjRay debug lines

	API:
	 ProjectileClient.EnableClientRendering()          -- call once on the client
	 ProjectileClient.SetImpactHandler(fn(position, normal, model, kind))
	     -- replaces the built-in flash/ring effect; see Impact.luau
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = script.Parent
local Heartbeat = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Heartbeat"))
local ChunkManager = require(Shared:WaitForChild("ChunkManager"))
local VisualOffload = require(Shared:WaitForChild("VisualOffload"))
local Protocol = require(Shared:WaitForChild("ProjectileProtocol"))
local Codec = require(Shared:WaitForChild("ProjectileCodec"))

local DebugRays = require(script.DebugRays)
local Impact = require(script.Impact)
local Prediction = require(script.Prediction)
local Types = require(script.Types)
local View = require(script.View)
local VisualModel = require(script.VisualModel)
local BeamVisual = require(script.BeamVisual)

type Visual = Types.Visual

local Channels = Protocol.Channels

local ProjectileClient = {}

function ProjectileClient.SetImpactHandler(fn: (Vector3, Vector3, Instance?, string?) -> ())
	Impact.SetHandler(fn)
end

-- Pass-by: every frame each visual moving at least passMinSpeed (studs/s,
-- dilation included) is checked against the camera; one that was closing in
-- and then goes past calls the handler once with its closest point, speed
-- and miss distance (only if it came within passRadius). Projectiles that
-- only ever move away -- your own shots -- never count.
local passByHandler: ((Vector3, number, number) -> ())? = nil
local passMinSpeed, passRadius = math.huge, 0

function ProjectileClient.SetPassByHandler(fn: (Vector3, number, number) -> (), minSpeed: number, radius: number)
	passByHandler, passMinSpeed, passRadius = fn, minSpeed, radius
end

-- Matches the server's own default -- used only if a spawn payload is ever
-- missing MaxRealLifetime, which shouldn't normally happen.
local DEFAULT_MAX_REAL_LIFETIME = 60

-- Range loss is now explicit, not inferred from missing homing updates.
-- Under heavy load a bounded pose stream can legitimately pause for seconds;
-- only server death/range exit or the real-lifetime backstop removes it.
-- Hard cap on visible Transform work in one client frame. Exact off-screen
-- trajectories defer prediction until needed; complex ones retain simulation. The
-- persistent round-robin cursor is independent of dilated time, so changing
-- GlobalTimeScale cannot collapse previously staggered cohorts onto one frame.
local MAX_VISUAL_UPDATES_PER_FRAME = 2500
local SMOOTH_RADIUS = 100
local MAX_SMOOTH_PROJECTILES = 500
local SMOOTH_SET_REFRESH_INTERVAL = 0.1 -- real seconds; selection is presentation-only
local DEFAULT_SMOOTH_DURATION = 1 / 60

local clientRendering = false
local visuals: { [number]: Visual } = {}
local deferredVisuals: { [number]: Visual } = {}
local visualCount = 0
local visualOrder: { number } = {} -- append-only between compactions; dead ids are tombstones
local visualCursor = 1
local visualTombstones = 0
-- Sum of global (dilated) dt since rendering began; a visual's
-- lastSimulationTime is a reading of this clock.
local globalSimulationClock = 0
local smoothVisuals: { Visual } = {}
local nextSmoothSetRefresh = 0

local function visualInView(visual: Types.Visual, position: Vector3): boolean
	if visual.rig and visual.rig.beam then
		local center, radius = BeamVisual.GetBounds(visual, position, globalSimulationClock)
		return View.contains(center, radius)
	end
	return View.contains(position)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Smooth set: the nearest visuals get per-frame interpolation
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function refreshSmoothVisuals(now: number)
	if now < nextSmoothSetRefresh then
		return
	end
	nextSmoothSetRefresh = now + SMOOTH_SET_REFRESH_INTERVAL

	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart)
	debug.profilebegin("ProjectileClient.RefreshSmoothSet")
	-- Keep only the nearest K candidates in a max-heap, so this never sorts
	-- every nearby visual when only MAX_SMOOTH_PROJECTILES can be selected.
	local heapVisuals: { Visual } = table.create(MAX_SMOOTH_PROJECTILES)
	local heapDistances: { number } = table.create(MAX_SMOOTH_PROJECTILES)
	local heapSize = 0
	local function swap(a: number, b: number)
		heapVisuals[a], heapVisuals[b] = heapVisuals[b], heapVisuals[a]
		heapDistances[a], heapDistances[b] = heapDistances[b], heapDistances[a]
	end
	local function push(visual: Visual, distanceSq: number)
		heapSize += 1
		local index = heapSize
		heapVisuals[index] = visual
		heapDistances[index] = distanceSq
		while index > 1 do
			local parent = index // 2
			if heapDistances[parent] >= distanceSq then
				break
			end
			swap(parent, index)
			index = parent
		end
	end
	local function replaceRoot(visual: Visual, distanceSq: number)
		heapVisuals[1] = visual
		heapDistances[1] = distanceSq
		local index = 1
		while true do
			local left = index * 2
			if left > heapSize then
				break
			end
			local right = left + 1
			local largest = if right <= heapSize and heapDistances[right] > heapDistances[left] then right else left
			if heapDistances[index] >= heapDistances[largest] then
				break
			end
			swap(index, largest)
			index = largest
		end
	end
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		local rootPosition = root.Position
		local radiusSq = SMOOTH_RADIUS * SMOOTH_RADIUS
		for _, visual in visuals do
			local offset = visual.position - rootPosition
			local distanceSq = offset:Dot(offset)
			if distanceSq <= radiusSq and View.contains(visual.position) then
				if heapSize < MAX_SMOOTH_PROJECTILES then
					push(visual, distanceSq)
				elseif distanceSq < heapDistances[1] then
					replaceRoot(visual, distanceSq)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local selected: { [Visual]: boolean } = {}
	local newSmoothVisuals: { Visual } = table.create(heapSize)
	for index = 1, heapSize do
		local visual = heapVisuals[index]
		selected[visual] = true
		table.insert(newSmoothVisuals, visual)
		if not visual.smoothTransform then
			visual.smoothTransform = true
			visual.lastSmoothStep = now
			visual.lastSmoothTarget = nil
		end
	end
	for _, visual in smoothVisuals do
		if not selected[visual] then
			visual.smoothTransform = false
			visual.lastSmoothStep = nil
			visual.lastSmoothTarget = nil
		end
	end
	smoothVisuals = newSmoothVisuals
	debug.profileend()
end

local function setSmoothTarget(visual: Visual, now: number)
	local previousTarget = visual.lastSmoothTarget
	local duration = if previousTarget
		then math.clamp(now - previousTarget, DEFAULT_SMOOTH_DURATION, 0.1)
		else DEFAULT_SMOOTH_DURATION
	visual.lastSmoothTarget = now
	VisualModel.SetTarget(visual, visual.position, visual.velocity, duration)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Visual lifecycle
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Removes the flying tracer. Impact VFX is played from the ProjHit handler
-- itself, so this fires for real hits AND harmless expiry without ever
-- flashing in mid-air. The bullet DISAPPEARS instantly, but the actual
-- :Destroy() waits out the longest lifetime among the effects that were
-- emitting (or DestroyDelay, whichever is longer) -- see VisualModel.Retire.
local function destroyVisual(id: number)
	local visual = visuals[id]
	if not visual then
		return
	end
	visuals[id] = nil
	deferredVisuals[id] = nil
	visualCount -= 1
	visualTombstones += 1
	VisualModel.Retire(visual, visual.destroyDelay)
end

-- Adopts an authoritative pose as of NOW. Every server pose (spawn, bounce,
-- sync transition) is an end-of-server-frame snapshot, so the next
-- render-loop visit must only integrate time that passes after receipt --
-- not the backlog since this visual's previous round-robin visit, which
-- already happened before the pose was taken.
local function rebaseline(visual: Visual, position: Vector3, velocity: Vector3)
	visual.position = position
	visual.velocity = velocity
	visual.simulationDebt = 0
	visual.lastSimulationTime = globalSimulationClock
	visual.deferredPrediction = false
	deferredVisuals[visual.id] = nil
end

local function onSpawn(data: Protocol.SpawnPayload)
	if visuals[data.Id] then
		return
	end
	-- Beams are timestamped, but catching up the transit time on arrival put
	-- a fast packet tens of studs downrange on its first frame. Like every
	-- other projectile, start from the received pose: shift this packet's
	-- epoch by its own transit time, and every later correction by the same
	-- amount so they don't snap it forward again.
	local beamTimeOffset = nil
	if data.Beam and data.ServerTime then
		beamTimeOffset = math.max(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - data.ServerTime, 0)
		data.ServerTime += beamTimeOffset
	end
	local model, rig = VisualModel.Build(data)
	local now = os.clock()
	local inView = View.contains(data.Position, data.Beam and data.Beam.Length)
	local visual: Visual = {
		id = data.Id,
		model = model,
		rig = rig,
		destroyDelay = data.DestroyDelay or 0,
		-- See VisualModel.FadeOut -- both default true.
		waitForParticles = data.WaitForParticles ~= false,
		waitForTrails = data.WaitForTrails ~= false,

		position = data.Position,
		velocity = data.Velocity,
		gravity = data.Gravity or 0,
		acceleration = data.Acceleration or 0,
		accelerationDirection = data.AccelerationDirection,
		minSpeed = data.MinSpeed or 0,
		maxSpeed = data.MaxSpeed or math.huge,
		life = data.Lifetime,
		simulationDebt = 0,
		-- Combined Source.TimeScale * projectile.TimeScale; updated live via
		-- ProjTimeScale -- see the "Local time" section of the server module.
		timeScale = data.TimeScale or 1,
		lastSimulationTime = globalSimulationClock,
		deferredPrediction = false,
		synced = data.Synced == true,

		-- Real (undilated) safety-net cap. spawnRealTime is THIS client's own
		-- os.clock() at spawn -- fine, since this only needs to be a generous
		-- backstop, not an exact match to the server's own cap.
		spawnRealTime = now,
		maxRealLifetime = data.MaxRealLifetime or DEFAULT_MAX_REAL_LIFETIME,
		lastUpdate = now,
		beamTimeOffset = beamTimeOffset,

		lastRenderStep = now,
		inView = inView,
		offscreenSince = if inView then nil else now,
		culled = false,
		effectCullDelay = VisualModel.GetLongestEffectLifetime(model),
		smoothTransform = false,
		transformElapsed = 0,
		transformDuration = 0,
	}
	BeamVisual.Attach(visual)
	if data.ActivateParticlesOnCreate then
		VisualModel.ActivateParticles(model)
	end
	visuals[data.Id] = visual
	visualCount += 1
	table.insert(visualOrder, data.Id)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Message handlers
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Fires only when the combined personal/local TimeScale actually changes --
-- not a per-frame stream. The client just needs the number; from here it
-- predicts locally exactly like it already does for chunk/world dilation.
local function onTimeScale(data: Protocol.TimeScalePayload)
	local visual = visuals[data.Id]
	if not visual then
		return
	end
	if not visual.synced then
		-- Settle time already elapsed at the OLD scale first; otherwise the
		-- new scale would be applied retroactively to the whole backlog
		-- since this visual's last round-robin visit.
		local elapsed = globalSimulationClock - visual.lastSimulationTime
		if elapsed > 0 then
			Prediction.simulate(visual, elapsed * visual.timeScale)
		end
		visual.lastSimulationTime = globalSimulationClock
		visual.deferredPrediction = false
		deferredVisuals[visual.id] = nil
	end
	visual.timeScale = data.TimeScale
end

-- Homing lock acquired/dropped -- rare, only on an actual transition, never
-- per-frame. Synced switches the visual into "trust the streamed ProjMove"
-- mode; unsynced switches it back to local physics. Either way the message
-- carries the server's pose at the transition, which is the only correct
-- starting point for local physics after a lock drops.
local function onSync(data: Protocol.SyncPayload)
	local visual = visuals[data.Id]
	if not visual then
		return
	end
	visual.synced = data.Synced
	rebaseline(visual, data.Position, data.Velocity)
	if visual.synced then
		-- Reset the staleness clock right at the transition, so a lastUpdate
		-- left over from before it can't immediately read as stale before the
		-- first real ProjMove arrives.
		visual.lastUpdate = os.clock()
	end
end

-- Batched authoritative pose updates. Two kinds of entries:
--  - Bounced = true: a one-shot bounce correction, applied whether or not
--    the visual is synced (for a non-homing bouncer it is the ONLY update
--    between spawn and impact). Snaps instead of tweening -- a straight
--    tween from the old position would cut through the surface it bounced
--    off -- plays the ricochet flash, and re-baselines local physics.
--  - Otherwise: ordinary continuous homing, or a timestamped beam correction.
--    Beams predict between snapshots regardless of the ordinary Synced flag.
local function onMove(batch: { Protocol.MovePayload })
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, data in batch do
		local visual = visuals[data.Id]
		if not visual then
			continue
		end
		if visual.rig and visual.rig.beam then
			BeamVisual.AdoptPath(visual, data.BeamPath, data.BeamClipped)
			local serverTime = data.ServerTime
			if serverTime then
				serverTime += visual.beamTimeOffset or 0
			end
			BeamVisual.AdoptMotion(visual, serverTime, data.GlobalScale, data.BeamPreviousId)
			if data.TimeScale ~= nil then visual.timeScale = data.TimeScale end
			if data.Lifetime then visual.life = data.Lifetime end
		end
		if data.Bounced or data.Corrected then
			visual.lastUpdate = now
			rebaseline(visual, data.Position, data.Velocity)
			BeamVisual.Correct(visual, data.Point or data.Position)
			if visual.rig and visual.rig.beam and visual.rig.beam.group then
				BeamVisual.Update(visual, data.Position, data.Velocity)
			end
			if visualInView(visual, data.Position) then
				VisualModel.SuspendTrails(visual)
				VisualModel.Place(visual, data.Position, data.Velocity)
				visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate = now
				if data.Bounced and BeamVisual.ShouldPlayImpact(visual, data.Point or data.Position) then
					Impact.Play(data.Point or data.Position, data.Normal, "bounce")
				end
			end
		elseif visual.synced or (visual.rig and visual.rig.beam) then
			local duration = math.clamp(now - visual.lastUpdate, 0.03, 0.2)
			visual.lastUpdate = now
			rebaseline(visual, data.Position, data.Velocity)
			if visual.rig and visual.rig.beam and visual.rig.beam.group then
				-- Retain authoritative curvature while offscreen; no Instances
				-- are moved here. Re-entry must not invent a homing shortcut.
				BeamVisual.Update(visual, data.Position, data.Velocity)
			end
			if visual.inView and visualInView(visual, data.Position) then
				VisualModel.SetTarget(visual, data.Position, data.Velocity, duration)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function onHit(data: Protocol.HitPayload)
	local visual = visuals[data.Id]
	if visual then
		BeamVisual.AdoptPath(visual, data.BeamPath, data.BeamClipped, true)
		rebaseline(visual, data.Position, visual.velocity)
		-- Snap to the server's exact position before destroying, so any
		-- imperceptible mid-flight drift from local simulation never shows at
		-- the one moment it would be visible.
		if data.BeamBody then
			BeamVisual.StopBody(visual, data.Position)
		else
			BeamVisual.Correct(visual, data.Position)
			VisualModel.Place(visual, data.Position, visual.velocity)
		end
		if data.Kind and BeamVisual.ShouldPlayImpact(visual, data.Position) then
			Impact.Play(data.Position, data.Normal, data.Kind)
		end
	end
	destroyVisual(data.Id)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Render scheduler
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Visual came back on screen: place it without drawing a trail across the
-- jump, restore it if it had been fully culled, and resume effects on a
-- later update.
local function reenterView(visual: Visual, now: number)
	VisualModel.SuspendTrails(visual)
	BeamVisual.Reset(visual)
	VisualModel.Place(visual, visual.position, visual.velocity)
	visual.culled = false
	visual.resumeEffectsOnNextUpdate = now
	visual.offscreenSince = nil
end

-- Roblox performs draw culling. Keep the rig parented; after the authored
-- effects' grace period we suspend emission and prediction/interpolation work.
local function recoverStalePose(visual: Visual, position: Vector3, now: number)
	local rig = visual.rig
	if rig and rig.beam and rig.beam.group then return end -- shared geometry is flushed once per channel
	-- Native culling uses the Instance's last rendered bounds. If a camera turn
	-- exposes those stale bounds while the current trajectory is still outside
	-- view, move them outside too. No scene unparenting/visibility override.
	local model = visual.model
	local renderedPosition = if rig then rig.root.Position
		elseif model:IsA("Model") then model:GetPivot().Position
		elseif model:IsA("BasePart") then model.Position
		else position
	if visualInView(visual, renderedPosition) then
		VisualModel.SuspendTrails(visual)
		VisualModel.Place(visual, position, visual.velocity)
